As soon as the war starts, switch your Conscription law up to at least ⟦0⟧ and trigger the Balance of Power decision now available called Appeal to the Finnish Spirit (if you want to min-max it, watch your manpower's mobilization status and switch up to a higher Conscription Law every time you reach the limit and then run out of Manpower). Don't forget to grab the ⟦1⟧ subdoctrine, as this makes a huge difference. Make sure to queue up divisions for training immediately because you will need them as soon as possible. Also, Aland is demilitarized until the war starts, so it doesn't hurt to queue up 2 ⟦2⟧ and 1 ⟦3⟧ on Aland as soon as the war starts and the restriction is lifted. This will let you breathe a little easier when garrisoning it.

As soon as you can, spend your remaining PP choose the decision to Open Up Political Discourse (75 PP). After that, if you have enough PP, take the decisions to Discredit the Government (50 PP), which gives a big Communism boost, and then take Expand Civil Support (25 PP) as many times as you need to get the required support to Hold a National Referendum (100 PP).

As soon as you finish your first focus, hire the ⟦0⟧ advisor from it. While we will aim to have them as a leader later, losing them as an advisor, their buff is so strong and they cost so little that it is still mathematically worth it to hire them. For your next hirings, grab the ⟦1⟧ and the ⟦2⟧ who specializes in ⟦3⟧. When your first leader's public trust falls under -60%, take the decision to have a Vote of No Confidence. Your new leader's public trust drops under different conditions, so while they are in charge, Ban ⟦4⟧. After doing so, you might need to run an Anti-Fascist Raid to get ⟦5⟧ under 20% (but don't let it fall under 10%). This leader's buff provides a discount to law changes, so use this time to move up to ⟦6⟧. Queue up a ⟦7⟧ or two and then start to spam ⟦8⟧. After this second leader also falls under -60% public trust, vote them out as well.

As soon as you have enough political power, justify wargoals for your cores in ⟦0⟧ and then Xibei San Ma. Declare war as soon as possible. Shanxi is easily mowed down as they should only have two divisions. You don't even need to destroy them, just run around them and grab the land. Shanxi should capitulate in less than 20 days. Train as many infantry divisions as possible for the upcoming wars. For national focuses, focus on getting a third research slot, getting rid of ⟦1⟧ and to improve your Stability. It might be possible to reach above 50% during war time early, thus avoiding Strikes, but do not count on it. Focus your political power on the Silent Workhorse, The Popular Figurehead, lowering the Conscription law to Extensive, improving your Economy and Trade laws, as well as getting the cheap Genius Army Chief.

As soon as you're done with the focuses, justify war goals on both ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ to retake your core states. Set your starting army on the border with ⟦2⟧ and your 6 militia divisions on the border with ⟦3⟧. Begin production of an Early Cruiser with the bare minimum specs (one gun, a fire control, and an engine). Put all your dockyards on it (pull them off convoys for now). Add Support Artillery to your divisions along with Infantry Guns. Start taking economic focuses, going after free factories at first. After you run out of those, you can go back for army bonuses left in the fascist tree and then tackle the democratic section in order to remove your last bad national spirit. Dedicate your construction queue to spamming ⟦4⟧ for the rest of the game as well.

As the general formula can be complex to calculate without a special tool, simpler calculations for special cases can provide quite useful: whether for approximating a chance by substituting similar numbers or for calculating the exact chance if the numbers align. Each case will be provided with three paragraphs — The formula in the first paragraph, an example in the second paragraph, and a general explanation of why it applies (though not necessarily a rigorous proof) in the third paragraph. The total chance will be given on the scale of ⟦0⟧; focuses are assumed each to have a positive value, as negatives are unintended and a focus with a chance of zero will never get picked by the game's AI meaning they can be excluded from the calculation entirely; and the modifiers applying to the focus' AI will do value (e.g. from AI strategy plans or the bonus for continuing the same branch) have already been applied, as multiplying the result of the rolled dice by a number would be the same as multiplying the ends of a range by that number. In shortened form, the ai_will_do value of a focus will be referred simply as the "focus' value".

As The Netherlands, you control a puppet with a large manpower pool: Indonesia, also called the Dutch Indies. Their industrial capacity is weak and their division template is primitive, but there is a way to use Indonesian manpower in combination with Dutch industry. As Indonesia is an Integrated ⟦0⟧, you can train a division from a colonial template, which will be filled with 0% from your manpower and 100% from the puppet (less if Indonesia promotes to a colony). But you can also duplicate this template and edit it, and it will still draw 100% manpower from your puppet. So add some more infantry, some artillery, maybe even a bit of armor to the duplicated template. To gain the required army experience, you will need to hire a military theorist early, or exercise your divisions a lot. With this strategy, you can field a 750 000 man army and stop the German attack right at the border instead of sacrificing 2/3 of the country.

As the path Spain chose to take in its focus tree you'll start with more than half of the Republican provinces and army at the time of the uprising, but unlike other sides, you won't be getting any foreign aid. Try to capture Madrid and other provinces with military factories so you can keep producing guns, and concentrate your strong units in provinces with planned offensives to create and then reduce pockets. In general, just play a smart war. If things take too long, International Brigades and Foreign Equipment Purchases focuses can keep your materiel supplies healthy.

As the Philippines, rush down the monarchist path as fast as possible up to the war for independence. If you're lucky, America will just give you independence without having to do the war - otherwise reset since its relatively early. After independence, just keep allying and attempting to annex as many Hispanic nations as possible, ideally the ones with the most manpower or factories first (Chile, Argentina, Mexico, and Spain). These annexations can actually be savescummed even in ironman mode, but the most critical one is Spain - if they reject annexation/allying, you need to reset or savescum. From here, strategy is dependent on circumstances & preference. If playing on historical mode, you should attempt to Sealion the UK with the Axis - you can join the faction for their assistance flooding troops in after landing/paradropping, but defeating the UK is significantly harder in historical now as a minor nation without tanks or air (though you can at least gain supremacy for a naval invasion prior to declaring war). If you can't kill the UK in historical before the US joins the allies or a dominion becomes a major, you have to defeat them as well. Even if you can kill the UK, you need to have gained enough warscore to annex both the Indian and Malaysian & Indonesian states required for the achievement (this is easier if you keep a separate faction, but then killing the UK before 1941 is even more difficult). As of 1.19.1 not all Indonesian states are required for the "Form Maphilindo" decision, so keep that in mind for the peace deal. Do the "Malayo-Polynesia" focus to get claims on Malaysia and Indonesia and therefore will be cheaper in the peace deal. Also note that the achievement description is misleading, you need specifically the Indian states from the achievement requirements.

As the Russian civil war broke out in November 1917, the Bolsheviks, who had taken over the official government, signed the Brest-Litovsk Treaty, in which they agreed to have a ceasefire with the Germans and ceded parts of western Russia to the advancing German troops. Estonia declared its independence by February 1918. The withdrawal of forces in western Russia after the German surrender in 1918, allowed the Bolsheviks to advance through heading west. Allied forces, in hope of ensuring the independence of Estonia, and hoping to stop the communist advance to the Baltic states, allowed the deployment of the German Freikorps, German anti-communist paramilitaries. The war for independence lasted 14 months and ended with the failure of Red Army troops to conquer the Baltic states and the forced withdrawal of Freikorps from Estonia.

As the war goes on, the ⟦0⟧ will attempt to naval invade you an increasingly large amount. Make sure you've garrisoned all 6 ports with at least 1 unit and have a couple extra ones that can shuffle around to beat back invasions. Be especially careful about Aland, which will be hard to reinforce due to ⟦1⟧ convoy raiding subs. You may need to Last Stand against naval invasions there on rare occasion. You will want to garrison the ports because you don't have enough units to cover the entire coastline (obviously), but you are still technically vulnerable in some states with a lot of coastline like Uusimaa. They can also naval invade Petsamo, which is one of their more dangerous tricks, since they'll probably be hitting that tile with 12 units simultaneously (3 from both adjacent tiles and a 6 unit naval invasion).

As the world tension reaches 50% (allowing justification of war-goals as non-aligned), and your luck is good, justifying on both Latvia and Estonia before Soviets send their ultimatums can allow you to reform the Baltic Unified States early (sometimes the Soviets start their justifications on Baltic states early, and their event forces the small nations to choose annexation with 100% certainty, robbing you of a chance to even declare war). It would also get Latvia and Estonia joining Axis as you declare the attacks. If you wish to join Allies, remember to start the justification first, as otherwise being in a Democratic faction can limit your war justification targets considerably. Conquering Latvia and Estonia can be done with a handful of 3-sized cavalry divisions (the template for which could be used for resistance suppression later) that prioritize going for victory points.

As with any fascist nation playthrough, if one's ambitions know no bounds, then there is theoretically nothing stopping Imperial China from embarking on a quest to finally make the Emperor of China the ruler of "all under heaven" both in name and in reality. Essentially a world conquest, with China united, Russia conquered and either Allied or Axis territories secured as well, Imperial China will be well positioned to continue its meteoric rise, indiscriminately invading, conquering, seizing and subjugating whatever it desires, and reshaping the entire world in its image, creating a New World Order of its own. As with practically all minors, the player should choose to swing away from democracy (and non-aligned) and choose between the Fascist ideology or the Communist. As you can see, we have created a meta_effect that takes two arguments. These arguments will be used replacing the parameters [EQ_TYPE] and [EQ_LEVEL] inside the meta effect. EQ_LEVEL will be replaced by [?eq_level|.0] which is the integer value of eq_level (in this case 2.000 becomes 2). EQ_TYPE is a bit more complicated, it is being replaced by a scripted localization. This scripted localization will check eq_type variable and depending on its value it will return the key token for the equipment. If it is 0, it will return "infantry_equipment". If it is 1, it will return "artillery_equipment".

As you gain more ⟦0⟧, steadily increase the combat width of your Infantry template up from 8 to 24. Add in Support Anti-Air and Engineer Company as support companies for now. You'll want to add in Recon Rangers, Field Hospitals, and Logistics Companies later as you can, but not until you're closer to being caught up on research.

As you will only have around 150k manpower, you should use 10-widths with four ⟦0⟧ battalions and a ⟦1⟧ line battalion (take the ⟦2⟧ subdoctrine later to improve it), because ⟦3⟧ air superiority and close-air support will be a menace. For the SPAA design, just use an Inter-War Medium Tank's default setup except change to a Medium One Man Turret, Basic Anti-Air Gun, a Diesel Engine (you don't need the speed), and the role of Anti-Air. This design works well for the entire playthrough, and you don't need to research a single tank technology except Inter-War Tank Development (note that Towed Anti-Air is required as well to have access to that gun). It's worth mentioning that ⟦4⟧ can also help combat for the skies and keep the enemy wasting time building planes, but they are quite a large construction expense. If you don't get them though, you will definitely need both Dispersed Industry and Armored Trains (and probably to put 5 full factories on them for a while) because the ⟦5⟧ will switch to Logistics Strikes after they realize they aren't winning. If you went Concentrated Industry or don't want to bother with the Armored Trains, just max out at least one province worth of ⟦6⟧ in each air sector.

As a result, indenting does not matter: most files can be done on one line in total without any change in how they get interpreted. However, doing indenting properly can make detecting bracket problems much easier without using a text editor's bracket highlighting and overall makes it easier to see at a glance what each block includes within of itself and what it doesn't. Aside from the branches' top level focuses, most other focuses have additional requirements in need of fulfillment before they can be picked. If a requirement of an on-going focus has become invalidated, the focus will either be paused until the requirement is restored (if possible) or outright be cancelled when such a thing is not easily possible. For cases such as the latter, focuses will have bypass conditions to allow the player to proceed past them - the player will be notified of the bypass within a few days (they will display a golden bracket as if completed regularly). For example, Motorization Effort can be bypassed if the Motorized Infantry technology has already been researched beforehand.

Aside from the countries covered in the focus tree, you won't have to justify on ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧, or ⟦6⟧; former 3 will get eaten by Germany, ⟦7⟧ can give you a War goal through an event, and ⟦8⟧ will eat the latter 3). Unless the French AI has flipped to ⟦9⟧, they'll still have ⟦10⟧; launch naval invasions across the English Channel (take Secure the Italian Alliance to have the French divert their forces), and rush Paris (Cavalry, Motorized, or Tank Divisions with Motorized are ideal choices); while fighting the French, also justify on the ⟦11⟧ and ⟦12⟧, and then conquer them (and ⟦13⟧ if you got a War goal on them; if not, you can let the Germans take Luxembourg, as it's not that big of a help to them).

Aside from the obvious personal skill challenge (and potential status symbol a success would be), successfully taking a nation like Jan Mayen and elevating it to a global superpower and hegemon in the span of less than a decade would produce an alternate history scenario so implausible, so fantastical and so unbelievably unforseen, that to even the keenest and brightest of future historians in this timeline, it would appear as utterly impossible. And yet you successfully made it reality in spite of all odds and everything. You have surpassed the likes of Alexander the Great, the Ancient Romans and Genghis Khan combined by at least an order of magnitude, in this game at least. A successful Jan Mayen playthrough represents the apex of what ⟦0⟧ and other Paradox Interactive games thrive on; the ability to make history itself your sandbox and playground and craft whatever unique, unusual and bizarre timelines you desire.

Aside from these successes, however, Italy's military performance was poor. Its forces failed to make significant gains in France before the armistice, suffered a disastrous defeat in ⟦0⟧ in late 1940, and botched an invasion of British Egypt, advancing briefly before being driven back in Operation Compass. By early 1943, the Allies had expelled Italy from Africa entirely. That summer, Allied forces invaded the Italian mainland, leading to Mussolini’s downfall and the collapse of his government.

At a certain point, while preparing the defenses, Peru will declare war on you without warning. Both nations gain the Amazonian War buff, that unfortunately, cannot join a faction, but gain infantry buffs, and a 2% recruitable population. Fortunately, in Ecuador's case, it will gain additional 5 infantry brigades that spawn in the border with Peru which will help to turn the tide. You will stay in a defensive position on the border with Peru because the Peruvian AI will endlessly attack your line. After a period of time the Peruvians will have lost most of its manpower and equipment attacking your line and they won't be able to break through. When you see that the Peruvians are low on equipment then you can start to push and invade their lands without too many problems. Again though the key is to be entrenched and let their army grind away on your front line until their troops are weakened. Once this happens only then should you put your army on the offensive. It may be worthwhile to consider building more land forts and infrastructure on the border before the war to make things easier on your army when the Peruvian AI starts to grind away on you. Then when you capitulate them, you will just annex them.

At game start, assign your 9 starting ⟦0⟧ with 4 on infantry equipment, 1 on support equipment, 1 on artillery, and 3 on fighters. Queue up 1 truck, 1 anti-air, and 1 train for your next built factories to start producing. Delete your armor, cavalry, and mountaineer divisions and consolidate your air force. Train them up to level 3. In terms of construction, only build ⟦1⟧. Primarily build them in ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧, then ⟦6⟧ ⟦7⟧. When ⟦8⟧ is released as your integrated puppet, immediately queue up max ⟦9⟧ in each of their states to make sure the AI doesn’t build anything else. Do not build in the Sudetenland states. When you run out of building slots, build state AA in your provinces. Build a spy agency and start cracking the German ciphers. For research, the usual Electronic Mechanical Engineering, Basic Machine Tools, and Construction I combo is fine. One of your second researches should be the Basic Small Airframe. Although you will get bombed extensively in the early part of the war, it is recommended to go with Concentrated Industry to ensure you have enough equipment in time to meet the Germans, plus your fighters and state AA will help lessen the blow of bombing. Armored trains are also a good idea because of the bombing. In general you should be researching industry, infantry equipment, and air technologies.

At July 14~15 (which is about right after you complete these focuses, 560 days after 1936 start), Japan would start instigating a war with you through the Marco-Polo bridge incident, in which they will demand you to cede large swaths of northern territories or face war. Ceding territory effectively means that you'll lose multiple factories, withdraw away from more easily defensible positions, and Japan will only wait around half a year before declaring war on you to take you whole anyway. As a result, even with the ill-prepared state that your army is still in, it is still preferrable to stand your ground and fight rather than to appease them and buy time.

At the beginning of the 20th century, the Ottoman Empire had control over most of the Arabian peninsula. Subject to this suzerainty, Arabia was ruled by a patchwork of tribal rulers, with the Sharif of Mecca having pre-eminence and ruling the Hejaz and the Al Rashid Family ruling in Nejd but with the Al Saud family fighting to take control over Nejd. In 1916, with the encouragement and support of Britain (which was fighting the Ottomans in World War I), the Sharif of Mecca, Hussein bin Ali, led a pan-Arab revolt against the Ottoman Empire to create a united Arab state. Although the Arab Revolt of 1916 to 1918 failed in its objective, the Allied victory in World War I resulted in the end of Ottoman suzerainty and control in Arabia.

At the start of both the 1936 and 1939 scenarios, Mohammed Zahir Shah of the Barakzai royal family is the leader of Afghanistan. At the start of HOI4 in 1936 Venezuela is under the rule of President Eleazar López Contreras who was a former general under the previous dictator who had died in 1935. During these initial years of President Contreras rule, his focus was using the authoritarian system of government he inherited to force through new bills to develop the infrastructure of the nation as well as drafting a new constitution which would both start a process of Democratization of the government but also ban Communism in the country. Once World War Two started in 1939, Venezuela's primary focus became the protection of its oil industry from possible sabotage and to exploit the need for oil to increase its economy. Due to the fact the nation declared its neutrality in 1939 it became a notable nation in regards to its role to continue to sell oil to ⟦0⟧, Germany, and ⟦1⟧. It was this very reason however that also drew the attention of The ⟦2⟧ who would impose a blockade which caused all trade to Germany to cease. During this economic boom while Venezuela would sell oil to both the Axis and Allies, the nation would take the opportunity to finance the modernization of its military by purchasing aircraft from the ⟦3⟧ and vessels for its navy from ⟦4⟧. Under intense pressure from the Allies, Venezuela would break off relations with the Axis in 1941 after which several Venezuelan freighters would be sunk by U-boats in the Caribbean. In addition Venezuela would grant the Allies full access to its airfields and harbors in order to patrol against further U-boat attacks.

At the start of the game, the player should focus on building up the industry as in any other country. Military factories should be a priority, as Argentina starts with plenty more civilian factories than military. While the building is on course, the player should also expand the military. However it is worth mentioning that most of the terrain of South America is hostile, having a lot of ground covered by hills, forest and mountains will make the use of vehicles a challenge. As such, an 7/2 Infantry artillery are a good choice to do. Companies that help with terrain such as engineer and recon companies will be useful. On the same note, an option that will prove useful with the use of artillery would be the Superior Firepower doctrine branch due to the great amount of soft attack it gives. (Consider that because of the terrain as well as all of South America are incapable of producing effective tank divisions, you'll seldom see armor). Although Mass Assault and Grand Battleplan doctrines also give useful bonuses such as extra manpower and lower infantry width, or extra planning bonus for breaking through the terrain. (Again, most times when attacking you'll have many maluses).

At the start of the game, the player should focus on expanding Brazil's industry. Having a large industry is vital for any nation and Brazil is no exception. Military factories should come first as Brazil has far fewer of them compared to its much more robust civilian sector. While industrialization is underway, the Brazilian military should also be expanded. This, however, may not be an easy task as Brazil has very little resources on its territory which hampers military buildup. Brazil happens to possess 14 units of rubber which can make small-scale vehicle production possible while importing oil can allow Brazil to potentially field and maintain a motorized army, something that can easily be a decisive factor against countries lacking motorized equipment.

At the top of the intel ledger are four buttons, each corresponding to one of the four intel types. Within each of these buttons is a percentage. This represents the intel level that the current country has on the target country in the associated intel type. Hover over one of these buttons will display a tooltip showing all intel sources that contribute to the total intel level on the target country. Selecting either of these four buttons will open up a screen showing detailed information related to that intel type; yellow chevrons on the left- and right-hand sides of a button communicate that the currently opened information is related to the indicated intel type.

But, the luck lies on whether if Aragon joins any faction or is guaranteed by another power, in that case it is either France or Britain. However, if the player hasnt invaded Galicia and Portugal yet, and choose to go with Aragon and Navarra, the same strategy will follow as mentioned above. Aragon starts with 4 infantry divisions, and with the preparation time being done, they will likely raise the number of units or switch templates. Take all the mainland of Aragon and they will capitulate thereafter. Just like Galicia beforehand, Aragon will also have a sizeable navy. And, you will gain Aragon's Italian lands of Sicily, Sardinia and Malta, to which they will serve for the expansion of the Emirate of Sicily decision. Navarra being the next target, will be easy, with one swift take after justifying on them, it wont be much of an issue.

At this point, the manpower has become limited, thanks to many occupied states that await formable decisions, and the population being unable to produce more. It is time to turn to your puppet states and use them to produce many troops as you can, just to protect any naval invasions perpetuated by Allied Forces (Notably the US) Trading resources with your puppets it isnt costly. And by one factory request, you can trade as much amount of resources needed to produce planes, motorized or support equipment in ease.
At this point, you already have Hungary, Bulgaria and most of Yugoslavia as well as a large army in production, things are going according to the plan.

At this point, you could declare on United States and use your Pacific and Asian powers as well as potential allies the Soviets to declare on the United States and invade them from.the East. After island-hopping all the way to Hawaii, and conquering Attu Island and Alaska as well, I then used Hawaii as a naval base to launch an invasion into California. After overrunning the West Coast I spearheaded my way through the weakly defended center states all the way to DC on the other end. It requires some braveness, a lot of stupidity, so much micromanaging, and guts to do it, but it was worth it at the peace conference when I liberated the US and all their island territories and became the second biggest Communist power in the world.

At this point, you could pursue ⟦0⟧ if you wished. At this point, you have two options on how to proceed:

At this point, you should've flipped communist already, so start justifying on ⟦0⟧. At the same time start working on the political focuses. Make a template of one cavalry unit, and spam it out. You should also have a fair amount of political power at this point, so take some stability-increasing decisions. At this point, you should've flipped fascist already, so start joining the Axis while Germany deals with the European theatre. At the same time start working on the political focuses. You should also have a fair amount of political power at this point, so take some stability-increasing decisions and maybe a Captain of Industry. At the same time make an amount of research on planes, notably fighters, medium bombers, and produce at least 50 transport planes. Take the paratrooper units along with the airforce and place them in Western France, if Germany has capitulated France. Establish dropping points into UK, and join once the airforce is ready and trained. It will be time delaying once as you join the war aerial dominance has to be on your favour in order to make landings in Wales, Northern England and London. Germany in this case or any of the Axis powers will automatically provide support for the invasion. Once your paratroopers land in Wales, be sure to rush down and occupy almost all of it before the British troops defeat you in Cardiff.

Austria is an extremely difficult nation to play. The Germans are on your border, and will attempt to annex you. You have until around 1937-1938 to prepare. Focus on the industry branch of the focus tree, getting as many military factories as possible. You should then focus on the political branch. Going democratic or communist is ideal, so you can join a major faction when the Germans invade. Remaining fascist can get you manpower though, if you decide to remain fascist, ally Italy if possible, or Japan, though allying with Japan is less rewarding. You should make a lot of weaker infantry divisions, instead of trying to get ideal stats. This tends to make the AI hesitant to attack your lines. When the Germans attack you will mainly want to hold out in the mountains. If you are not playing iron man, you should save before the Germans press for Anschluss, because if the Germans make it through the mountains, they will have a stronger attack. Once you make your defensive line, you can just wait until the German AI overwhelms itself. Joining the Allies or Comintern will speed this up. Once you defeat the Germans, your army should be big enough to establish dominance in central Europe.

Baltic-Belarus is a collective term used to refer to three very closely related formable nations, namely; Estonia-Belarus, Latvia-Belarus and Lithuania-Belarus. These formable nations can be formed by each of the three Baltic States ( ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧) and only one of them can be formed at any given time. The historical background for these nations is that they are each a reconstitution of the short-lived Socialist Soviet Republic of Lithuania and Belorussia, a Soviet puppet state that existed for approxmately five months during the Lithuanian-Soviet War and Polish-Soviet War of 1919-1920.

Battalions, sometimes called "combat battalions", "line battalions", or "line troops", are the frontline troops of a division. They are organized into at most 5⟦0⟧ brigades (represented as vertical columns) that can have up to 5⟦1⟧ battalions each (initially 4⟦2⟧, but increased to 5 with ⟦3⟧), totaling up to a maximum capacity of 25 battalions per division. Battalions fall into six broad categories: ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧, ⟦6⟧, ⟦7⟧, ⟦8⟧, and ⟦9⟧. Each brigade may only have battalions from the same category, but can have any combination of battalions within that category.

Because Chile lacks a diverse amount of resources and manpower it can be quite challenging to build up and maintain a respectable military to contend with the other neighbouring nations. However, the steel resource abundance makes it up for massive gun producing to a maximum extend. As such, when it comes to military build-up, Chile should strive to collect all the low-hanging fruit that is within its reach to secure every advantage it can. In other words, try to focus on maximizing the utility of all options that you have access to resource-, factory- and manpower-wise.

Because Communist China lacks both resources and manpower it can be quite challenging to build up and maintain a respectable military to contend with the other Chinese factions. As such, when it comes to military build-up, Communist China should strive to collect all the low-hanging fruit that is within its reach to secure every advantage it can. In other words, try to focus on maximizing the utility of all options that you have access to resource-, factory- and manpower-wise.

Because of the terrain (mountainous) and weather (jungle, hot, storm), the attrition is very high and armor (tanks) is not very effective. Better to focus on a lot of Infantry, armed with Artillery, to succeed in the Andes and surrounding jungles. Air superiority is not a major problem; your neighbours have small Airforces. After you turned Fascist (or Communist), the access for your Navy through the Panama Canal is blocked, but you can build a Naval Base at the Pacific coast in Cundinamarca (or western La Libertad) to maintain access to both sea regions.

Because of their diluted bonuses spread across so many things, helicopter brigades are most effective when they are paired up with one or two dedicated support companies for its roles while also acting as a minor replacement for a different dedicated support company. For example, if a division would previously have had both a logistics company and a field hospital and the player has decided to use it in a theater where supply usage is a huge concern but still wants to minimize manpower losses, it can be beneficial to swap out the field hospital for a helicopter brigade to get that extra bit of supply usage reduction without completely losing all of the field hospital's bonuses.

Because you are no longer limited by your manpower (high Conscription law + ⟦0⟧ + many focus buffs) or Infantry Equipment (thanks for the guns, ⟦1⟧), the easiest way to prepare for offense is to duplicate your Infantry template and save the new one under a different name and icon. Keep your port garrison troops on the older template but switch your front line over to the new one. Now slowly add additional Infantry units to the new front line template one by one as your resources permit, until you reach your preferred offensive combat width size (I went with 18 on a whim). When you're ready to push, replace the ⟦2⟧ with a ⟦3⟧ (to conserve manpower) or a ⟦4⟧ (to help with bad supply areas). You can also add SPGs if you prefer. I would not recommend ⟦5⟧ unless you plan to switch out of ⟦6⟧ and grab ⟦7⟧, as ⟦8⟧ aren't worth using much until they have that combat width reduction. From here, just wait for the Germans to join the war (or do it yourself if you're feeling frisky). The collab government + them getting exhausted by you will allow you to cap them by mid-1942. Once capped, just leave the game running till 1944. And that's it!

Before going down political paths (except for Organise the peasant's strike), it is highly recommended to rush to the focus "Agrarian reform," which removes the Looming Peasants Strike National Spirit. Also, complete the "Clamp down on Danzig" focuses down to "Integrate Gdańsk Industries" as quickly as possible, since Danzig will give you 7 factories and remove the awful Embargoed Economy law. In fact it is probably best to choose "Clamp down on Danzig" as your first focus regardless of what political direction you wish to take. After "Clamp down on Danzig" is complete, immediately do the decision "unification propaganda" with the 75PP you are given. After that, choose "raid Nazi resistance" when you regained your PP. Finally, doing "unification propaganda" one more time should give you enough compliance and low enough resistance to do "Ban the Nazi Party". Meanwhile, complete the focuses "The Four Year Plan" and then "Polish School of Mathematics" for an extra research slot. After getting the research slot you should be able to Ban the Nazi party. After this, immediately do "Integrate Gdańsk Industries" to remove Embargoed economy, and after this rush down for Agrarian Reform. Finally, before doing any political focuses, complete "National Defense Fund" which gives you -15% consumer goods for 2 years. It's best to do this focus early because, after getting attacked by the USSR and Germany, you'll likely be on War Economy or Total Mobilisation for the rest of the game and the focus will no longer be necessary. Additionally it gives you crutial industrial capacity to build up your country in preperation for the fascist and communist onslaught.

Before the First World War, ⟦0⟧ was part of the Ottoman Empire. The Ottomans were defeated and driven from much of the area by the ⟦1⟧ during the dissolution of the Ottoman Empire. On 11 November 1920, Iraq became a League of Nations mandate under British control with the name "State of Iraq". The British installed the Hashemite king, Faisal I to govern the mandate. Britain would then grant independence to the Kingdom of Iraq in 1932, on the urging of King Faisal. King Ghazi ruled as a figurehead after King Faisal's death in 1933, while undermined by attempted military coups, until his death in 1939. Ghazi was followed by his underage son, Faisal II. 'Abd al-Ilah served as Regent during Faisal's minority.

Being assigned to ⟦0⟧ a technology earns the MIO 500⟦1⟧ funds multiplied by the base cost of technology when the technology has been researched. A technology with a base cost of 110⟦2⟧ days would earn 500 funds, one with a base cost of 165 days would earn 750 funds, one with a base cost of 99 days would earn 450 funds, etc. If progress has already been made on a technology before the MIO is assigned to it, the amount of funds gained upon completion is scaled to the percentage of the research that was done with the MIO assigned. As the amount of funds that a MIO receives depends only on the technology's base cost, not the actual time required to research it, it can be beneficial to choose to research technologies with available research speed bonuses if a player wishes to rapidly increase the size of a MIO. ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧ where bonuses can be acquired by spending ⟦5⟧ can be especially potent. On the flipside, researching technologies ahead-of-time will not provide an assigned MIO more funds, so doing so can result in a lot more ⟦6⟧ having to be spent on the MIO's research relative to the amount of funds it will gain from performing that research.
Being assigned to a ⟦0⟧ earns the MIO 0.1⟦1⟧ funds per ⟦2⟧ per day, up to at most 100⟦3⟧ funds per day.

Belgium has some advantages over the Netherlands. Although it still has no focus tree (as of the final versions of Update Barbarossa, most recent DLC being No Step Back), this can become a strength as Belgium is unhampered by negative national spirits, and the generic focus tree allows for a quicker ideological switch and nearer industry focuses. Belgium also has some advantages in the military; however, a player Netherlands can draw upon the (potentially million) manpower of the Dutch East Indies with Colonial templates; fortunately, the AI does barely makes use of this.

Belgium lies in a rather fortunate position between an alliable Germany, a pacifist Netherlands and rather pathetic Luxembourg. France could provide a formidable foe but more times than not simply won't put troops on the border even when you are actively justifying against them. To take advantage of this one should immediately begin by selecting political effort and hiring the Fascist Demagogue while waiting one should choose the industrial focuses although infrastructure effort should be saved for after the impending civil war. Any upgrades to the army would be wasted as the enemy in the civil war would gain the same bonuses. You should be able to turn fascist by 1937 at the latest. After you have turned fascist you should begin the production of Transport planes fighters and CAS. Immediately justify the Netherlands and Luxembourg and join the Axis. When at war with the Netherlands simply paradrop into The Hague Amsterdam and Rotterdam to capitulate them For your focus tree go down the nationalist path for man power. You should focus mostly on mils at this point but it is up to you. Mobile warfare is the best doctrine. After getting the Netherlands and Luxembourg annex them but puppet the east indies and request their garrison report. Take care not to call in the Germans as they will steal all the land in the conference. When you feel you are strong enough (and when France has joined the allies) then justify a war goal on a British puppet such as British Malaya. Wait for an event where they will move troops from your border and lose their entrenchment such as Italy joining the axis or Nationalist Spain being victorious in the civil war then declare war. Call in the Germans as it shouldn't matter as they can't penetrate the Maginot. Push onwards to Paris and capture it thus capitulating France. Don't worry if you capitulate as the Germans should liberate you and then capture the French lands in the name of your country. After this send around a full army group (24 divisions) to guard all the ports in your empire. You should have enough planes to gain superiority over the south of England if you have focused well and if not it's only a matter of time. Feel free to declare war on any non major country if you think you can capitulate them or if you can't but their landlocked or very far away (they should capitulate after the UK does as the UK is the only major but be wary nevertheless) try not to declare war on any American nation as the US guarantees them due to Monroe Doctrine. Once you have ample air superiority in southern England then paradrop into an undefended city on the south coast that has a port Portsmouth is usually good. Once you have taken it send across one or more army groups across the channel. Bombing their navy may be a good idea to stop them intercepting the crossings. Once the army groups are across conquer them as quickly as possible .In the peace deal take the eastern most states of Canada and puppet the rest. Creating a lot of puppets is advised for the troops they will survive. The Axis should be in a much stronger position by now but still only join Operation Barbarossa if you feel you can take down the Soviet Union. When you feel ready you can justify on the Philippines and invade the USA from your Canadian lands. Rush their victory points and you can win easily. Puppet them and use their navy to invade Japan (as long as they are still fighting China) invade them with around 2 army groups. At this point you can invade everyone you want from the protection of the axis. After this simply leave the axis and conquer them when you are powerful enough.

Between 1932 and 1933, Peru entered a year long war with ⟦0⟧ over a territory dispute on their borders. The war resulted in a stalemate, and peace was soon brokered by the League of Nations, and the borders remained unchanged. Border skirmishes in the summer of 1941 led to all out war with ⟦1⟧ though the war eventually bogged down and became a stalemate. In the end Ecuador suffered more casualties and had to cede the disputed territory (this is represented in the game through a decision). As neither nation was supported by the major factions of the Allies or Axis it was the only war during World War Two not to actually be considered part of the then ongoing World War. During the war years Peru would be forced to trade more heavily with the ⟦2⟧ due to the loss of European trading partners. However in the early years of the pacific war due to the geographical position of Peru the United States would provide Lend Lease aid in the form of more modern American military equipment. This in turn would further increase tensions in the region as both Chile and Ecuador were concerned that Peru would make use of its newly modernized army to attempt to seize further territories it claimed.

Between 1936 and 1939, political and social divisions in South Africa intensified. The Representation of Natives Act (1936) removed Black South Africans from the Cape voters’ roll, further entrenching their political disenfranchisement. During this period, Afrikaner nationalist organizations such as the Ossewabrandwag gained prominence, expressing sympathy for Nazi ideology and reflecting anti-British sentiment among some Afrikaners.

Between 1941 and 1944, during World War II, Nazi Germany and its allies, Hungary and the Independent State of Croatia, occupied Vojvodina and divided it. Bačka and Baranja were annexed by Hungary and Syrmia was included in the Independent State of Croatia. A smaller Danube Banovina (including Banat, Šumadija, and Braničevo) was designated as part of the area governed by the Military Administration in Serbia. The administrative center of this smaller province was Smederevo. But, Banat was a separate autonomous region ruled by its ethnic German minority.

BMP files contain a DIB header at the beginning that assigns image file information. The game is set-up to expect BITMAPINFOHEADER as the format of the header for all BMP files. This depends on the image editor and most should save within this one by default. However, other formats for the header exist: the most common one to accidentally save in is BITMAPV5HEADER, written by the GIMP foundation. This is used in order to add the ICC information, characterizing in which colour space the image has to be read in. ⟦0⟧. For this reason, ⟦1⟧ in order to save with BITMAPINFOHEADER rather than BITMAPV5HEADER.

Bordered on the east and west by expansive oceans, Canada is relatively secure from amphibious invasions if playing on the Allied side. Additionally, the United States is directly to the south of Canada. In a traditional game (i.e., the United States, ⟦0⟧, and Canada are all members of the same faction), Canada's geography virtually ensures that it is safe from attack. Britain begins the game with an overwhelming naval presence due to her large number of ships and ability to base them nearly anywhere in the world. Because the range of ships is limited to one or two tiles from the nearest naval base, Britain's presence in the Atlantic, Pacific, and Indian Oceans, as well as her presence in the Mediterranean Sea, should not be underestimated. With the exception of Hong Kong and British Malaya, most of these bases are far from historically belligerent powers and relatively unlikely to be attacked, while still providing access to critical shipping lanes such as European trade with South America. Britain's ability to interdict convoy shipping and protect her own in these sectors is considerable; even if she loses Hong Kong and Singapore she can quite easily influence the course of trade and supply the world over. Maintaining control of Hong Kong, Singapore, and the Mediterranean bastions of Malta, Cyprus, and Gibraltar can give Britain a significant advantage in naval basing capabilities, as can maintaining control of the Suez Canal. In addition to the aforementioned points, it is worth noting that Britain can base her ships in any nation of the Commonwealth - even nations that show as different "colors" such as Australia and New Zealand.

In the Pre-war years the nation maintained overall very positive relations with Germany due in large part to the sizable German immigrant population controlling many of the most productive plantations in the country and President Ubico comparing himself to Adolf Hitler. So strong were relations that the German Navy would make port calls and make Guatemala City the main distribution hub of Nazi propaganda in the Central American region. As such during the opening stages of World War Two the country pursued a policy of neutrality though under pressure from the ⟦0⟧ this would change in 1941 when like its neighboring Central American nations it declared war on the Axis Powers. During the war the President Ubico attempted to keep Guatemalan involvement in the conflict limited though he would allow an allied airbase to be constructed in the country, deport several hundred German immigrants to the United States for internment, and opportunistically seize German owned plantations. In 1944 there would be a popular democratic revolution against President Ubico which lead to his overthrow and the installment of Juan José Arévalo as Guatemala's first democratically elected president.

By the time Hearts of Iron IV begins, Mexico is in a state of considerable disarray, having endured nearly two decades of political and social unrest. In 1876, President Porfirio Díaz seized power in a political coup and proceeded to rule continuously until 1911, a period known as the Porfiriato. Following the collapse of Porfirio Díaz's regime in 1911, Mexico descended into a prolonged and violent civil war, known as the Mexican Revolution, which persisted for a decade until 1920. Subsequently, the Cristero War commenced in 1926, precipitated by a theological and political schism between the Catholic Church and the Mexican state. It persisted until 1929. Subsequently, a degree of peace and stability was restored to Mexico, commencing with President Plutarco Calles' tenure from 1924 to 1928 and continuing with the Maximato from 1928 to 1934.

By the time the war starts you may have four or more of these fleets created. It should be more than sufficient especially if you have a mixture of level 2 ships in your Task Forces. A second reserve fleet may be needed in the Philippines to combat losses of ships and swell the ranks of the Asiatic Fleet.

By the time war with the ⟦0⟧ begins, Romania should have four armies. One army should be excluded from the army group and placed along the Anatolian coast, as the Soviets are not averse to naval invasions and the Romanian navy is no match for the Soviet Black Sea fleet. The other armies should be placed on the front-line in Moldova. ⟦1⟧ or whichever puppet was granted the eastern Anatolian provinces will place troops on that border, but no puppets should initially be called into the war. As the war begins, it might take a while for the enemy to begin mounting attacks, but they eventually will. ⟦2⟧ will be forced to capitulate sooner or later, but that is no issue. The player will simply have to hold the line long enough for the Red Army to exhaust its reserves of manpower and equipment. The Soviets will heavily bomb the Romanian industry, but that cannot be prevented. The Romanian air force will have to defend the Eastern Balkans region to prevent the forts there from being destroyed. As the Soviets suffer casualties in the millions attacking the Romanian borders, the Romanian army should be no worse for wear. The player should also begin building armoured divisions once the infantry divisions are sufficiently up to strength. Those armoured divisions should consist of 6 medium armour brigades and 4 motorized (later mechanized) brigades.

By the time you can conquer Xibei San Ma, they will likely have joined the United Front. You can either go with ⟦0⟧ alone, or have the ⟦1⟧ defeat all Chinese factions. If you do the latter, create a puppet ⟦2⟧ or Communist China and give it all the Chinese territory.

By the war's end over 15% of all Canadian citizens would serve in uniform (out of a prewar population of 11 million) and Canada would possess the fourth-largest air force and fifth-largest naval surface fleet in the world. Canada's industrial contribution to the war was highly significant, particularly in the form of raw materials and motorized vehicles (Canada was the second-largest producer of wheeled vehicles after the ⟦0⟧). Canadian troops fought on all fronts in Western Europe, particularly in Italy and in France, during and after D-Day.

By the way, I recommend pulling your submarines off the main fleet into a second one and setting that second fleet to patrol only in the Eastern North Sea. All ~25 submarines you have should give you just over 150 Naval Dominance, and the UK does not contest the Eastern North Sea against you until after the war starts.

By this point, the queued divisions should have been trained to a level where enough can be manually deployed to bring the fielded manpower up past 400K. The player should do so and then pick the Puppet Bulgaria focus. Almost always, the Bulgarians will give up their independence without a fight, but if they decide to fight, it should be easy to conquer them.

By this point, the year should be 1940 or 1941. If you have been building your industry as described above, you will have gotten the District 9 achievement as well, and releasing any 1 Subject, such as Namibia, while independent will also grant you the I am the Tong Master achievement. Unless your Invasion of the Levant gets crushed like mine was, you can probably also go on to win the War and potentially get the Rule Britannia achievement.
By this point, there are very few nations that can stand up to you (the United States, USSR, and a fully unified China are the most notable examples), so feel free to do whatever you want.

By this point, World War 2 has kicked off - justify and declare on the Allies, and then join the Axis. Use paratroopers to gain a foothold in the UK, and take their victory points. In the peace deal, take the required French and British territories (Franche-Comte, Jordan, and Palestine). Then, declare war on and annex Vichy France (attack from Franche-Comte) - no other country will guarantee them since they're fascist, and since you're still in the Axis, you can attack them without fear of them calling in the Germans. After defeating them, Satellite Free France (if you puppet Vichy France, their focus will have them join the Axis) and return the French lands you have to your Free French Puppet (so that way, the Germans can't occupy it when you go to war with them). When the Axis go to war with the Soviets, wait until they're a good way in before leaving and justifying on them - because Italy and Germany are both majors in a war, you can justify quickly on them. Attack and optionally join the Comintern (ideally the Soviets still have a border with you so they can send their forces to help you). During the peace deal, ta3ke the required German (Niederschlesien and Oberschlesien) and Italian (Tuscany, Lombardy, Emilia Romagna, and South Tyrol - while the last one isn't required for the achievement, it is one of your cores) territories. You don't have to fight the Soviets for any territory if they don't take or puppet any of the states required for the achievement (the only thing the Soviets would demand from you is Bessarabia, and that's not required), Japan will leave you alone if you didn't puppet the Dutch East Indies or British Malaya, and the United States won't pick a fight with you - just focus on re-annexing France through the annexation system. Feel free to build a battleship by this point for the other achievement if you didn't already have one from puppeting the British.

By this time, you should have gotten the Panay Incident if you haven't already - while the historic thing would be to demand compensation, as we're already derailing history, instead use it to gain a war goal. Use either the Philippines (if you decided to Secure China) or Vladivostok (if you decided to join the Comintern) to naval invade mainland Japan. Because Japan is likely still involved in China, they won't have many forces in the Home Islands.
By this time, your Early Destroyer should be done. Your Early Cruiser is probably telling you it will finish in late 1939, but once Concentrated Industry II finishes, it will bump that timeline up.

Canada's geology and great size bestows the country with mineral wealth. Canada is an oil producing country. Its most productive oil fields were the Turner Valley oil fields which had been discovered on 14 May 1914. Production at Turner Valley peaked in 1942 at about 10 million barrels which constituted about 95% of Canada’s oil production and represented 0.48% of world crude oil production in 1942. The downside of the increased production was, as feared by the industry insiders, the lowering of the gas pressure, which ultimately shortened the productive life of the field.

Canada's military in 1939 was small, poorly-equipped, and technologically outdated, despite measures taken by the government of Mackenzie King in 1936 to gradually increase the gutted defense budget. After the outbreak of war, Britain placed responsibility for the protection of North America in Canadian hands, and the nation placed military expansion and modernization as a top priority.

Changes in the effective recruitable population ratio can cause one of the two population counts to overflow. In this case population is transferred to the other population type. For example, if a country raises its recruitment law, the civilian population cap will go down over time (according to the mobilization speed), which causes some civilian population to be transferred to recruitable population. Conversely, if a state is captured by a country that does not have a core on it, the recruitable ratio will be massively reduced and might cause recruitable population to transfer back to civilian population.

Changes in the recruitable population modifier and recruitable population factor do not apply instantaneously. Instead the value drifts towards the new target according to the ⟦0⟧. The base mobilization speed is ⟦1⟧ per day. For example, at 50% war support it takes 250 days to fully shift from limited to extensive conscription. War support and some national spirits can modify the base value. The recruitable population ratio only changes in steps of 0.1%/day, so it takes between a week and a month before any new manpower becomes available, depending on mobilization speed.

Characters/Unit leaders: These are finicky in the game's core. When a character is promoted to a unit leader position, all tokenizations of that character's token will begin to return a different value, representing the token for the unit leader with the same identifier, which is linked to, but not the same as, the original character. The unit leader version of the token returns the same ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧, but it is ⟦2⟧ This can come into play if code compares the equality of two character-pointing variables.

Chiang was released on 26 December and returned to Nanjing with Zhang Xueliang. Although he announced a cease fire in the civil war, he repudiated any promises that he had made in Xi'an. Zhang was imprisoned and charged with treason. Chiang then sent 37 army divisions north to surround the Northeastern Army and force them to stand down. The army was deeply divided on the appropriate response. Yang Hucheng and the Anti-Japanese Comrade Society wanted to stand and fight if the KMT army attacked, and refuse to negotiate until Zhang was released. The Communist representatives strongly disagreed and cautioned that civil war would, in the words of Zhou Enlai, "make China into another Spain". Negotiations between the CCP and Nanjing continued. However, when a conference of Northeastern officers in January 1937 overwhelmingly resolved not to surrender peacefully, the CCP reluctantly decided that they could not abandon their allies and pledged to fight alongside them if the KMT attacked. The situation was again reversed when the five most senior Northeastern generals met separately and decided to surrender. The radical officers were enraged and assassinated one of the generals on 2 February, but this only turned the majority of the soldiers against the plan to stand and fight. The Northeastern Army peacefully surrendered to advancing KMT forces and was divided into new units, which were sent to Hebei, Hunan, and Anhui. Yang Hucheng, however, was arrested and eventually executed, while the leaders of the Anti-Japanese Comrade Society defected to the Red Army. Zhang was kept under house arrest for over 50 years before emigrating to Hawaii in 1993. Chiang did eventually keep his promise to the CCP. After six months of continued negotiations, he signed a formal agreement creating the Second United Front, a military alliance of the Communists and Nationalists against Japan.

China also suffers from the Nation Spirit "⟦0⟧", applies an immense ⟦1⟧ penalty to all division attack and defense, making China's military very ineffective in combat. This makes China's military so weak in fact, that when taking into account Japan's division templates this means that a force of comparable Chinese units might still lose a battle even when outnumbering the Japanese. You are essentially sending your men into a fight they are not likely to win and the only military strategy that China is capable of pulling off at this stage, given its incompetent leadership, is sending in its disorganized units en masse and relying on its massive army to win the day. Significant casualties are to be expected for your soldiers and it may very well be that China's rivers will have to run red with the blood of their sacrifice if China is to have any hope of an independent future.

Another diplomatic problem China has is one of its national spirits, "Communist Uprisings", which, if communist support rises high enough, will cause a random state to switch over to Communist China's control. Civil wars can also be triggered by foreign-funded attempted coups. For this, a country must conduct the relevant intelligence agency ⟦0⟧ with La Résistance or a diplomatic action costing 200 Political Power (0.5 per day) without, and supply Infantry ⟦1⟧. The amount of infantry equipment required appears to be a function of the target country's civilian population, with more equipment required for more populous countries.

Civil wars can be incorporated into military strategy if one so chooses. A nation can choose to start a civil war in a another nation to weaken them prior to invading them. An example could be Germany starting a civil war in the ⟦0⟧ to weaken the country before invading it.

Civil wars can be influenced by foreign nations in many ways. The two most notable include sending volunteers and lend-leasing equipment. Once a civil war breaks out, the nation that supplied Infantry equipment for the rebels can offer further support by providing additional equipment through Lend-Lease. In addition to supplying basic things such like Infantry Equipment, a nation can also choose to provide advanced equipment like Tanks and/or Artillery for the rebels. This can allow the rebels to more effectively supply their military which can grant them an edge over their opponents.

Civil wars may occur based on the popular support for a certain ⟦0⟧. If the support for a certain ideology that is not currently ruling in a country grows too large, they will start demanding a change of government. If the player ignores the clamor for reform or actively refuses to allow reform the chance of a civil war breaking out will grow. It will then start with an event allowing the player to choose their side. It is also possible for the growing ideology to start a coup, which would allow for a peaceful transition.

Colombia became independent from the Spanish Empire on August 7, 1819. From that time until 1903, ⟦0⟧ was a province of Colombia. Shortly after, the contract and Hay–Bunau-Varilla Treaty for the construction of the Panama Canal was signed between French engineers and the ⟦1⟧, one of the most prestigious engineering projects in history, finishing in 1914. The Monroe Doctrine was established in 1823 by the United States, to prevent further interventions of the European powers in Latin America. In 1904, this was expanded in the Roosevelt Corollary that stated the United States had the right to militarily intervene in case European countries sought renewed colonialism in Latin America. Following this, Colombia, together with ⟦2⟧, tightened relations with the United Kingdom.

Colombia declared its neutrality under Eduardo Santos when World War II broke out. Santos was opposed to the Axis powers. After López Pumarejo returned to power in 1942, he wanted to expand on the industrialization and economic reform started in his first term, but WWII impeded that. He was unpopular with the military commanders of Colombia and a coup was prepared to replace him. The coup d'etat failed in 1944 and López Pumarejo ruled until 1945, not serving his full four year presidency.

Colombia is the next nation for the challenge. Although similarly stronger as Peru, it possesses more strength than the latter, albeit and a bigger navy. But less of a chance for naval invasion. And, the sole option remains on continuing the land warfare with them. Their terrain is a mix of Jungles and Mountains, thus it is advised to deploy Mountaineer troops, not to forget to adjust support battalions on their way. Last but not least, be sure to have taken special forces doctrines for Marines and Mountaineers to increase your favors in your odds. Same starting strategy to be applied just like with the Peruvian War beforehand. Push the troops on the offensive line after they have been worn out from their attack. In the meantime, if Colombia is halfway done for capitulation, be sure to justify on Panama. It paints as an easy target, and fortunately the capital city is close to the Colombian border, making it quick to capitulate. Be quick to seize them first, as it will fall randomly in the hands of the Mexican forces if they go for the Central American focus

Colombia starts in a favorable geographical position with access to both the Caribbean Sea and the Pacific Ocean. Contextual localization is a way to access data from Localization Objects when localizing a string. The concept differs slightly from standard values ($VAL$) that can be injected into the localization string by allowing the localization string to select which properties to add to the resulting string and where. When a string is contextually localized with a localization object, then there's one root object (either a [Scope](loc_objects_documentation.md#scope) or [Localization Environment(loc_objects_documentation.md#localization_environment)]. In general this object can only be used for two purposes: Accessing other objects and getting the current date.

Cristeros Civil War and Communist Revolutionaries Civil War: Once you have completed a certain focus, you will get a chance to get either. These civil wars have multiple trigger to ignite, mainly the Church power level and the type of government. The Cristeros will not rebel if you choose to go Democratic path and likewise the Revolutionaries will not rebel if you go Communist. If you don't go Democratic, the Cristeros Civil War will start a countdown once you reach Atheist State, and likewise if you don't go Communist then the Revolutionaries Civil War will start a countdown once you reach Catholic State. Since some focuses will increase or decrease the Church Power by one stage, you need to pay attention to this, and you can also use some political decision to increase or decrease the Church Power though some requires some focuses to be taken first. You can ultimately prevent this civil war regardless of Church Power by keeping your stability above 60%. Likewise you can get away with Atheist State if you go Democratic and Catholic State if you go Communist with no risk of civil war which is not possible to do for Unaligned or Fascist path.

Depending on the value, the country is placed in some range representing the exact degree of power on a certain side. This is usually used to grant certain ⟦0⟧ or to execute an ⟦1⟧ upon entering it. Most ranges are placed inside of sides, making it only possible to enter when that side is active. A range may also not be assigned to any side and be always visible, usually used for a single "balanced" range in the middle. A range being assigned to a side only means that it'll be visible when the range is active, and a side may have ranges on both halves of the balance at the same time. Entering a range defined on a certain side does not necessitate that the balance is tipped in favour of that side. For example, if a side is set as a left side and yet it includes a range of ⟦2⟧ , then if the value is at 0.2, then the balance will be tipped towards the right side visually, but it will still be inside of that range.

Despite being aligned with other Democratic nations ideologically, historically Sweden was able to preserve its neutrality during the war. Sweden stayed neutral throughout World War I and II, siding neither with the Axis nor the Allies. But Sweden did let trains carrying German soldiers and supplies go through the country to both ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ (the so-called ⟦2⟧) to avoid getting into a war with the Germans. Sweden was also the biggest supplier of iron ore to Germany which is often discussed as a potential reason for its successful neutrality, with the metal provided accounting for about 58% of German supplies and 31% of British. The Swedish government allowed British access to its territory to ensure the delivery of the bearings through the German naval blockade. Sweden managed to decrypt the German Geheimfernschreiber (considered more complicated than the famous Enigma machine) in only two weeks in June 1940 and over the course of the war, Sweden spied on German intelligence. In some rare cases, Sweden actively supplied information to the allies about this. The most famous such act was when Sweden provided information to the United Kingdom about the upcoming Operation Barbarossa, the German invasion of the Soviet Union. The British submitted the information further to Stalin who ignored it, with devastating results. Being a neutral country, tens of thousands of Jewish refugees fled to Sweden to escape the Nazi Holocaust.

Despite being landlocked, wedged between three European major powers and located smack-dab right in the middle of a continent ravaged by war, Switzerland stayed neutral and aggressively maintained that neutrality in both world wars, earning it the reputation of being the ultimate neutral country as it was never invaded even once in either war, whether due to successful deterrence, economic concessions and due to bigger things being at stake.

Despite being neutral at the start of the game, the small sultanate will usually not last long, as Italy will demand its annexation if they are winning in Ethiopia, which they almost always will in historical games.

Despite its apparent insignificance, Yugoslavia does not go unnoticed by the major powers. Germany has the national focuses ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧. The former allows Germany to demand Slovenia, with refusal leading to war, while the latter can result in the partition of Yugoslavia into Croatia and Yugoslavia, with one state annexed and the other puppeted, or both puppeted.

Despite its large amount of manpower and natural resources, the country's stability is torn apart as a result of old power struggles and paranoia, with purges on a regular basis intended to root out all conspirators with often detrimental side effects to the efficiency of management, production and command. Their military is in need of rapid modernization in multiple aspects to keep up with their European neighbors. And the Five Year Plan has only just started recently and would still require effort and time to reap the fruits.

Despite its small population of around 1.6 million at the time, New Zealand made a significant contribution to the war. Over 200,000 New Zealanders served in the armed forces, with the Royal New Zealand Air Force (RNZAF) playing a major role in the European and Pacific theaters. Many New Zealand airmen served with the Royal Air Force, while others were involved in maritime patrols and escort duties.

Different Factions have different disadvantages and advantages when it comes to securing resources. The Allies begin with the majority of Rubber production, and anyone going to war with them will have serious troubles with securing rubber without a plan to attack Allied South-east Asia, or without a lot of Refineries. Rubber is needed for all aircraft, as well as motorized/motorized artillery and mechanized. Most of the world's Chromium can be found in the Soviet Union, Turkey, South Africa, France, Cuba and Yugoslavia. Chromium is needed for ships and heavy tanks, as well as modern tanks. The only ships that don't require Chromium are Destroyers I-III, Light Cruisers I-III, Heavy Cruisers I-III, Submarines I-III. If you want to maintain a fleet of capital or modern ships, you will need to secure those places for yourself, or as allies. Aluminium can be found in France, the United States, Hungary, the Soviet Union, and Yugoslavia. Aluminium is needed for all aircraft, as well as support equipment. When planning your strategy you have to plan to either skip mass production of units requiring resources you don't have, or to plan to steal those resources from the enemy to secure your production or deny the enemy production of a particular equipment type. If you are playing as a minor nation, you might want to consider which side to join, if any, depending on the resources you will need to power your economy.

During Chiang Kai-shek's fifth campaign against Jiangxi Soviet, he named Chen as commander-in-chief of the southern front, commanding over 300,000 troops, or 30% of the 1,000,000 total Nationalist force mobilized against the communist base. Chen's job was to blockade the southern border of the communist base and prevent them from escaping from the south. However, ever suspicious that Chiang's true intent was to take over his territory as Chiang did to the local warlords in Fujian earlier, he participated in the campaign only half-heartedly. Although 300,000 of his troops were mobilized on paper, he only deployed 180,000, and their deployment was not complete until well after the Chinese Red Army had already passed Chen's territory. Furthermore, Chen made a secret deal with the communists that would ensure the Chinese Red Army would pass through his territory as fast as possible, while his forces would not stop them in the process. This arrangement would ensure the communists would be out of Chen's territory rapidly and that his forces would occupy the region the communists had passed, thus eliminating any excuse for Chiang Kai-shek to send troops into Chen's territory for potential takeover. The deal was carried out successfully and neither Chen nor the communists lost anything.

During that time, World War II broke out, and although Spain was considered an Axis friend, it did not join the war on their side. However, Spain seriously considered joining the Axis Powers to fulfill its imperial ambitions of reclaiming Gibraltar from Britain and annexing French Morocco, Oran, French Cameroon, and Rio de Oro from France. The Spaniards held negotiations with Germany and Italy in the fall of 1940 to discuss their entry into the alliance, culminating in the Meeting at Hendaye. The meeting eventually ended in disaster as Germany reneged on its initial promise to accept Spanish territorial requests for French Morocco, alongside Gibraltar, and to provide material assistance, following Vichy France's victory in the Battle of Dakar and the newfound importance of preserving its empire. An attempt by the Germans to get Spain to attack Gibraltar was also rejected by Franco due to the lack of commitment and worsening economic situation. Nevertheless, Spain would support the Axis in various ways throughout most of the war, all the while maintaining neutrality, most notably through the Blue Division, German U-boats operating in Spanish ports, the Gestapo operating in the country, and the shipment of tungsten to Germany.

From his power base in central Bhutan, Ugyen Wangchuck defeated his political enemies and united the country following several civil wars and rebellions during 1882–85.
During the 1936 and the 1939 start dates, Manchukuo is an Imperial Protectorate (puppet) of Japan.
During the 1940s and 1950s, the Belgian Congo experienced extensive urbanisation and the colonial administration began various development programs aimed at making the territory into a "model colony"

During the Cold War, Spain aligned with the ⟦0⟧, joining the United Nations and facing off against the Soviets.

During the First World War, Canada automatically entered the conflict on the side of the Entente as a semi-independent dominion of the British Empire. With the Statute of Westminster in 1931, Canada gained more autonomy within the bounds of its dominion status; However, like the other dominions, its constitution could only be amended by the British parliament, its highest court was in London, and all Canadians were British Citizens. Canada was a key member of the British Empire with strong ties to its parent country and followed Britain's declaration of war against Germany on the 10 September 1939.

During the Great Depression, the Japanese government had become increasingly militaristic, leading to the conquest of Manchuria in 1931, creating the puppet state of ⟦0⟧. In 1933, further Chinese border territories were also conquered, leading to further puppet states, like ⟦1⟧.

During the Imperial Federation talks, always go with the option where you spend the most political power. If you gave Canada all of North America, then they're less likely to agree to Imperial Federation here. If the talks succeed in every nation agreeing to federation, then give Canada all of North America. Canada will form the Dominion of North America, coring the entire United States, which you will inherit once you complete the final focus, Imperial Federation.

During the peace conference, liberate Manchukuo and Menchukuo as democracies and set up Japan as a democracy as well. If the United Kingdom has Empowered the King's Party and New Zealand has broken away, invite them to your faction and they should accept.

During the peace deal, focus on taking American land - the Axis will be mostly focused on Africa and Mainland Europe (if you didn't generate enough war score, take the coastal states + Alaska and Hawaii first, then the states bordering Canada and ⟦0⟧; then, take the rest of the inner states; if the Axis manage to make a puppet of the US with one of their cores, you should be strong enough to beat the Axis if you attack while they're dealing with the ⟦1⟧) - if you want to annex the US, you can puppet them using a non-core state and still take the decision. After defeating the US, select the "Install American Monarchy" decision (said decision will not pop up if you haven't completed Unite the Anglosphere), and release Scotland as a puppet.

During the peace deal, take the American States as well as the French-held Kurdish State - the Axis will mostly focus on African and European lands, and will only take land elsewhere if nothing else is left. Afterwards, conquer ⟦0⟧ the normal way, and go down to Expose the Belly of the Bear - either ⟦1⟧ will agree to become a puppet (in which case, get to work on annexing them) or use the war goal you get from them refusing to conquer them, taking the one Kurdish state in the peace deal.

During the Second Sino-Japanese War, Ma Clique forces fought against the Japanese and later Ma Bufang, overall leader of the Ma Clique, was ordered by the Kuomintang to invade ⟦0⟧ in the 1940s to intimidate and help oust the forces of the pro Soviet Governor Sheng Shicai.
