If you hold the SHIFT-button while drawing a field marshal front line, you get a field marshal front line without sub army front lines. This can be useful for front lines for a high number of defensive divisions. All divisions assigned to that front line get the color of the field marshal. In the picture a field marshal offensive line is assigned
If you intend to assault the Soviet Union, start building supply hubs along the border of Mongolia while you're still fighting China.

If you is at peace, armies should exercise so they can train until they reach regular status and earn ⟦0⟧. Adding an extra regiment, line battalion, or support company to an existing division design is an easy way to beef up one's forces – unless you don't have the equipment on hand to reinforce what you have.
If you just got the achievement upon capitulating the UK, congratulations! You're free from this achievement and can stop reading here.

If you lack a resource, but produce it locally (i.e. steel is produced, but not enough of it), try to avoid trading for it unless absolutely necessary. You can research excavation under the industry tab, which will increase the amount of your produced resources by 10% for each tier, up to 50% bonus if all tiers of excavation are researched. This will free up your civilian factories from trade and allow you to construct more buildings.

If you miss the timing and your justification will not finish until mid-October 1939 or later, cancel it. Instead, wait for Germany to declare on ⟦0⟧. Afterwards, World Tension will wildly spike, and you can directly justify a war goal on the UK in 40 days.

If you need a better deterrent against breaking a NAP, remember that division size doesn't matter and stacking your border with 1-size divisions increases the amount of divisions Germany or Soviet Union needs to bring to your border to break the NAP.
If you plan to do ⟦0⟧ after this, then focus on taking as much of the British fleet as you can (unless you prefer order 66).

If you release Kingdom of Barotseland, Republic of Biafra, Sokoto Caliphate, set ⟦0⟧ everywhere to Local Autonomy and then ask British Raj for garrison support - on 1936 start, you'll go from 303.05K to 670.82K (+367.77 British).

If you release Mariana Federation and set everything to Local Autonomy, ⟦0⟧ will give 30.11K garrisons; if you set everything to Forced Labor, ask ⟦1⟧ for Garrison support, and then release Mariana Federation and set everything to Local Autonomy, you'll get 100K Garrisons; 3 starting occupied territories on Local Autonomy need 10K. Whether or not to abuse ⟦2⟧ is your choice.

If you researches both ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ and also builds a rocket site , then ⟦2⟧ can be launched at distant States to damage their infrastructure. The main advantage of guided missiles is that they cost zero production and zero resources and do not tie up any military factories. Instead, guided missiles are automatically produced at each rocket launch site at the rate of one every 24 hours. Rocket sites have a maximum capacity of 100 guided missiles, which means that the launch site will be totally filled at the end of 101 days assuming no missiles have been launched. Further research into ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧ allows rocket sites to manufacture and launch ⟦5⟧ and ⟦6⟧ respectively. At present it is not possible to launch nuclear bombs using rockets.

If you select naval invasion, you will be asked to left-click on an origin point. This is where the army will gather for the assault. Right click on the enemy province you want to invade. Note that you will need to have some naval intelligence of every sea lane they will be crossing, so you will have to have warships patrolling or hold naval superiority in those sea areas.

If you still need ⟦0⟧ territory, Get ready for war with Germany. When Ready, Justify on ⟦1⟧ and declare war. Join the Allies as soon as possible so they can help but make sure to do most of the work. When the war is over, you will be able to take ⟦2⟧ and Eastern Polish Land required for the achievement.

If you still need ⟦0⟧, justify a war goal on them and take them as well. They may have joined the ⟦1⟧ at this point, but that's not really a problem, since you're the foremost world superpower now basically, and there's no way the ⟦2⟧ can handle you and the ⟦3⟧ at the same time.

If you Strengthen the Little Entente instead of joining the Allies, the war is likely to start in mid-1938 instead. This version of the war may be easier because you won't face trouble on the Belgian or Italian fronts and the Germans will be bogged down attacking ⟦0⟧. If instead France joins no factions they won't be called in for the attack on Poland but Germany will still attack in 1940.

If you survive this, join the allies once Germany declares war on Poland and watch the British push the Italians out of Ethiopia, you can help if you want to speed things along but be careful not to over reach. Once Ethiopia is liberated you can send your now very elite army off anywhere you feel like helping out however until Vichy France joins the war you wont be able to get any naval bases. Your options are somewhat limited and Axis submarines combined with not having many transports make it hard to move around but you can still help out and have some fun. Keep one or two divisions at home as Vichy France just seems to join at random and can march straight into your capital. Eventually Ethiopia will leave the Allies and make their own Faction so if you want to take them out I'd advise getting the focus that gives you a war goal on them as it doesn't run out so it's handy to have for when you want it. If you use the war goal as soon as they flip the invasion will be very easy however it can become almost impossible if you let Ethiopia build up again. Do not invite any allies as they will always get a higher war score and steal some land, making the consolidate the Horn of Africa decision impossible.

If you take the next two focuses in the focus tree, you will most likely create a faction with the United States (if they're democratic and you've been improving relations) called the South West Pacific Initiative and will also create a technology sharing group with them. The faction will also include the Philippines and the Dutch East Indies, because they are puppets of you and the US, respectively.

If you think you can handle it, you can accept the Bled agreement, so they raise their recruitable population and industry, which will make them a better puppet but slightly harder to overcome in the war. Either way, you should beat them easily.
If you wait a few days after the war starts to launch the naval invasion, you may get it for free because the AI pulled its garrison out of desperation.

If you wait for the timer to run down (allowing you to take the "Establish Carlist Cell" three times, so that you start the second round with three extra states), the second round will kick off in July 1937. You can try to start it earlier if you want to rush things (this timeline is already far longer than the strategy originally envisioned.)

If you wait long enough after winning the war with Japan, China will declare on ⟦0⟧, saving you the trouble and much of the risk (you might even leave the faction and join the Comintern, to make it easier).

If you wait too long with attacking the remaining South American nations, they might join either the Allies or the Axis, but this doesn't matter. You'll only have to occupy the states in question, a peace deal is not required.

If you want to continue playing after you've earned the achievement, save up about 750 political power and oust the confederation president (and elect new members so you don't get hit with the penalty) - that should move the balance of power scale back to a spot where you can begin running the "compromise with cantons" decision. Run that as needed until you get the balance of power to where you want it to be so that you can do the military focuses that you weren't able to do while rushing the land-grab focuses.
If you want to continue up to ⟦0⟧ also grab the Sapmi cores in ⟦1⟧.
If you want to do Jaguar Diplomacy, make sure you get non-aggression pacts BEFORE going Establish ULASR, as the cores you get will severely harm relations with the UK, ⟦0⟧ and the like.
If you want to do Red Hot Chile Peppers afterwards, the decision for a referendum will appear once you reach at least 60% communist support at any point in the run from now on.

If you want to free yourself from Germany before the start of the war, you'll have to start a civil war, and win it quickly, usually a week. You should win it quickly otherwise Germany will get called in. To start the civil war, hire a Communist Revolutionary, do Anti-Democratic Raids, Prepare for Civil War, then Ignite Civil War. (You can also do Democratic Reformer and Anti-Communist raids) You should hire the Army Maneuver Expert and push for the enemy capital, Presov, with both units (infantry and tank). If you manage to take their capital before Germany is called in, you will win the civil war, and you will be a free nation.
If you want to get ⟦0⟧, your faction should right now have 0 other countries in it. Release Iceland as a puppet. Now, when the ⟦1⟧ lose to you later, you'll get that achievement.

If you want to join the Allies it's advisable to focus on your naval and air capacity. You'll struggle to build a large ground force with low manpower so you'll mostly be restricted to support roles. 16 divisions should be enough to protect your territory, as once France and Norway have fallen the Germans will try to invade as you're a softer target than the UK. Build up some coastal forts and AA to protect yourself as if they take Dublin you're going to struggle to kick them out again.
If you want to know what the other side is up to, go over there and ask them directly!

If you want to use ⟦0⟧ and use the air wings to operate standard air missions, then they will no longer operate automatically as a Carrier Air Group and if the carrier fleet is engaged by the enemy, it may not have air cover. The player should be careful to make sure that it is properly protected. One might place a fighter wing on an interception mission in the region where the carrier fleet is located, but send a bomber wing to target an adjoining region, for example, to support an amphibious landing. In order to send carrier-based air wings on standard air missions, including ⟦1⟧ to help train them up for battle, their carrier(s) must be at sea (not in a port) and must not be on any ⟦2⟧.
If you want to use it within a ⟦0⟧, then you can use a similar concept. For example:

If you went with Friedrich, you'll also need at least 12 divisions to guard the Baltic ports against naval invasions. The Focuses The Belorussian Army and The Ruthenian Army can help you get a few of those divisions if your manpower is (too) low. Save at least 150 ⟦0⟧ for the start of the war, so you can immediately increase your conscription law. Finally, make sure you start gaining ⟦1⟧ in time because you want to switch your doctrine to Superior Firepower and preferably unlock the first few doctrines.
If you wish to change the nationality of a specific character, and the country getting the effect doesn't have the character recruited already, use the ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧
If you wish to do Red Hot Chile Peppers, hire communist advisors to turn ⟦0⟧. You should already control California.

If you wish to go further you only need to get Finland in the fold. Keep building various factories and dock yards and expand your army, but to not even think about fabricating a war goal on Finland until after the Winter War (Soviet invasion of Finland) has taken place - otherwise a democratic country will guarantee Finland. This might be a great way to trap the Soviets in a war against the Allies - but it also make things much more complicated for you.

If you wish to use this to go for the Arsenal of Democracy achievement, you must flip back to Democracy, but you don't have to worry about that - the US's Democratic Advisor, Harold L. Ickes, can be hired at any point, so after you get ahold of the required number of Military Factories (if you can join the Unions and annex Japan, you should have more than enough or at the very least, enough building spots to do so.
If you're going for Imperial Super Federation, then you need to annex Germany.

If you're lucky and fast, you will capitulate the ⟦0⟧ immediately. ⟦1⟧

If you're not interested in ⟦0⟧, another way to accomplish this achievement is to beeline for ⟦1⟧. Turn historical focuses on, then spend the first portion of the game building up your industry and your army, through both traditional methods and the use of your focus tree. Don't pacify the bandits; after you get Law University, rush your way down to Bolster Nationalism and recruit the bandits. ⟦2⟧ should ordinarily invest a little bit into Manchuria, and by taking the Divert Machine Tools decision repeatedly ⟦3⟧ should be able to reach 30-40 factories by 1941; one or two dockyards to build convoys is not a bad idea either. After that, you'll want to rush down the Mission To Germany branch before Germany recalls Von Falkenhausen, as this will be worth 3 factories, +1 planning skill on every leader, some free tanks, and an okay general, making this superior to the ⟦4⟧ tree; but this is not required. While all of the above is taking place, ensure that you research and begin training paratroopers, as well as building transport aircraft which are available at the beginning of the game. You don't need a ton but you can easily get to 8 paratrooper divisions before 1941, which will make the following steps easier.

If you're playing as ⟦0⟧, it's practical to send Volunteer tanks to both help Ethiopia and get Army experience. In fact, it's so effective, what it often gets banned in multiplayer - as it's ⟦1⟧ debilitating for ⟦2⟧.

If you're playing single player and wish to go for Georgia on my Mind, take Unholy Alliance, and wait for the Germans to come close to capitulating the Soviets, but don't join the war - when the decision is available, Join the Unions; as you're not at war with Germany, you'll force them back to their borders. Then, take Monroe Doctrine and take the decision to ask for the British territories - if they agree, congrats, you get the achievement!
If you're short on ⟦0⟧ for either design, set your entire Navy to train. It gets you 0.3 ⟦1⟧ per day based on the percentage of your Navy currently training.

If you're somehow still not at war with the Allies at this point, declare war on them, optionally join Axis, and naval invade the ⟦0⟧. One way that works reliably (even without the need to join the Axis) is to go across the North Atlantic. With the USA capitulated and their massive steel reserves at your disposal, ramp up naval output, invade Greenland, then Iceland, then Ireland (all three will be lightly protected), then, using Ireland as a staging area for your armies, launch simultaneous naval invasions aimed at several points across the Irish Sea. Once you have full control of their coastline from Liverpool to Glasgow and 48 divisions manning the line, UK's days are numbered. The hardest part will be amassing enough navy to get 50% naval superiority needed for the invasion.
If you're unlucky and haven't reached 13 members yet after you revolted all of the ⟦0⟧ African provinces, go for the ⟦1⟧ ones or the ⟦2⟧ ( ⟦3⟧ is pointless, far too high compliance).

If you're unlucky, you may not have enough warscore to take all of ⟦0⟧, especially if they were at war with ⟦1⟧. This isn't a big deal. Puppet what you can and leave their most expensive province. Make sure to take the navy. Just war them again later when the truce has expired.

If you've come this far, then why not go for the One Empire achievement? Assuming you take down Germany early, then you'll need to defeat the Russians yourself. They will demand Bessarabia from you because you annexed Romania. Deny their request. If they don't DOW you over it, then take out a war goal against them via your focus tree. Complete the focus to align Iran and Afghanistan too, the second front from the south really helps.

If your armor can exceed the enemy's piercing, then relevant combat bonuses await. 40% of the armor value is determined by the single highest armor battalion, so throw in a single very high armor battalion for that. The rest depends on the average values; try going for high-level mechanized Infantry to provide a high "baseline".

If your decision leads to a nation declaring war on another nation, there are several arguments that can be used to inform the targeted nation that a war is coming, as well as alert the AI to begin moving troops onto the border: ⟦0⟧ will make the game assume that the decision, within its ⟦1⟧ will declare war on the specified country, making it prepare when the timer starts. ⟦2⟧ will make the game assume that the decision, within its ⟦3⟧ will declare war on the specified country, making it prepare when the decision becomes available.

If your manpower hits 0, switch to no garrison and back to local police when you can. Replace your garrisons with Armored Cars or Light Tanks (build the cheapest, crappiest version possible - the stats do not matter) to help with manpower since resistance won't cost lives anymore due to the Hardness of your garrisons. You get 15% non core pop so you will win every fight eventually. Upgrade anti air maxing out guns. I usually send an advisor to Japan after Brazil. Get Japanese advisor for even more stats. Ignore ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧.
If your number of convoys begins to drop over time, build 2-3 ⟦0⟧. It should start going back up after that.

If your war was folded into the larger war, then you may not have had the required war participation to be "the country who was primarily responsible for capitulating the UK" and thus not earned the achievement.

If Yugoslavia turned communist early, immediately begin justifying a wargoal on Austria to weaken Germany. The national spirit buffs will help Yugoslavia with the war. After that, take Hungary to prevent them from joining the Axis. It is up to the player if it wants to annex the countries completely for resources or puppet to save manpower. The hard part comes to who you will invade. Declaring war on Greece will result in war with Romania, but without the French guarantee. Defeat Greece first before striking Romania. If the player done properly with its army, Yugoslavia will have every Balkan nation under its influence except for Bulgaria. Bulgaria's army restriction renders it defensive capability null to a Yugoslavian offensive. Just keep in mind that Italy will be close to war with Yugoslavia. If the player has puppeted Austria, Hungary and Northern Romania, Germany would be unable to attack the player from the north, leaving the Italian front a main focus. The Zara province won't be an issue due to its small supply maintenance, Albania would be guarded with a couple of divisions but no larger than 12 divisions. This would mean that the majority of the Yugoslavian army will be directed on the Istra border. With Soviet assist, it is unlikely that Italy would penetrate the Yugoslavian defense.
If, against all odds, the Russian White Exiles emerge victorious, the Russian Empire that fell in 1917 will be restored and a new Tsar will be crowned in Moscow.

If, on the other hand, one needs to trigger a civil war within their own country for reasons such as changing ideology (either through focuses or decisions), then there are two ways that you can easily win a civil war.

Immediately release Samoa as a puppet state. They will serve you far better as a puppet than as true territory, as in this way they can get all the free goodies that the generic focus tree provides, while still performing their role as an air and naval base in the pacific. They will be lucky to field even a single division, but that can still provide a garrison that you do not have to spend valuable manpower on. It will also result in, when you do eventually annex them, 3 military factories, 4 civilian factories, and 3 Naval Dockyards, in addition to whatever handful of destroyers and military equipment they may have built. Releasing Samoa will save you about 4.03K of manpower - since, when it gets released as ⟦0⟧, garrison gets sent back home.

Immediately research marines, submarines, and naval invasions. Build a large submarine fleet and naval dockyards. Follow the focus tree to become ⟦0⟧ and get the Anti Colonialist Focus once free from the ⟦1⟧. Prepare naval invasions to the ⟦2⟧ territories in Africa, leading to the ⟦3⟧ mainland in Europe. Prepare defensive units on the ⟦4⟧ border. Head to Liberate Portuguese Colonies in the focus tree.

Immediately start recruiting army and justifying on East India Company using the preexisting claim. Justification will take 65 days - enough time to deploy a few bare-bones divisions on the border with Malatya, but not enough time for East India Company to bring its units back to your borders.

Improving relations is initiated at the cost of 10 political power, and costs a base rate of .2 political power per day for a country with a matching ideology. If the improving relations action is taken with the target being a separate ideology, the cost per day is 0.4 political power. For example, if Germany was improving relations with fascist ⟦0⟧ it would cost .2 political power per day, but improving relations with the democratic ⟦1⟧ would cost .4 political power per day.

Note that the overall supply in the province increases by significantly more, because infrastructure has both a hub supply range and a state supply effect – more on state supply below.

In ⟦0⟧, this is done with the 'filter' menu. Filters are separated with spaces, and an exclamation point in the beginning marks it as an exclude filter. For example, ⟦1⟧ will result in searching every localisation file aside from the French ones.

In ⟦0⟧, this is in the 'where' menu. Filters are separated with commas, and a minus sign in the beginning marks it as an exclude filter. For example, ⟦1⟧ will search every text file in the base game (Assuming the default location within Windows on Steam) with the exception of those that begin with GER.

In ⟦0⟧, this is in the menu triggered with the 'Toggle Search Details' button, represented with an ellipsis. This menu has separate "Files to include" and "Files to exclude" menus, used accordingly. Additionally, this allows representing folder names within the menus, with the doubled ⟦1⟧ (as in ⟦2⟧) used to represent an arbitrary folder name. For example, ⟦3⟧ in the "Files to include" and ⟦4⟧ in "Files to exclude" will search every single file with the .gfx extension with the exception of those in the dlc folder.

In 1907, an epochal year for the country, Ugyen Wangchuck was unanimously chosen as the hereditary king of the country by an assembly of leading Buddhist monks, government officials, and heads of important families. The British government promptly recognized the new monarchy, and in 1910, Bhutan signed the Treaty of Punakha, a subsidiary alliance which gave the British control of Bhutan's foreign affairs and meant that Bhutan was treated as an Indian princely state. This had little real effect, given Bhutan's historical reticence, and also did not appear to affect Bhutan's traditional relations with Tibet. After the new Union of India gained independence from the United Kingdom on 15 August 1947, Bhutan became one of the first countries to recognize India's independence. On 8 August 1949, a treaty similar to that of 1910, in which Britain had gained power over Bhutan's foreign relations, was signed with the newly independent India.

In 1912 following the Xinhai Revolution, the Qing Dynasty collapsed, and the Republic of China was formed. However, various warlords also arose, carving out territories from the former empire. In 1921, with the Western powers having ignored pleas for aid in confronting the warlords, the ⟦0⟧ answered by supporting both the Communist Party of China and the much larger Chinese nationalist Kuomintang government of the ⟦1⟧. Under Soviet urging, the two sides formed the First United Front in 1923. In 1927, tensions between communists and nationalists flared, with left-wing KMT members either joining Mao Zedong's CPC or being purged by Chiang Kai-shek's right wing KMT. Soon, armed communist revolts erupted between both parties and the Ten Year Civil War began.

In 1917, ⟦0⟧ joined the Great War as a member of the Entente but their participation was more about moral support than anything else acting as a base against German U-boats in the Caribbean and a further 100 qualified doctors were sent to the western front. After the war, in 1925, president Gerardo Machado was elected and a period of modernization began with the Carretera Central being built which was a highway that crossed the entire island. Machado, however, stayed longer than his term but slowly through concessions to the opposition, the balance of power changed yet again and shortly after Machado's fall from power in the summer of 1933 both a general strike and a coup took place led by protesting students, and non-commissioned military officers, labor activists and the likes.

In 1919, after the October Revolution in Russia, Chinese troops re-occupied the country due to fears of communism spreading to mainland China. On October 1920, The White Russian General Baron Roman von Ungern-Sternberg led his troops into Mongolia, defeating the Chinese forces in the capital city of Ulaanbaatar. There, Ungern's eccentric, often violent treatment of enemies and his own men, earned him the sobriquet "the Mad Baron". In February 1921 he expelled Chinese troops from Mongolia and restored the monarchic power of the Bogd Khaan. In June 1921, Communist Mongolian Partisans aided by ⟦0⟧ established control over parts of the country and on July 6 The Bolsheviks would defeat the white army forces and seize the country for themselves, establishing a communist regime aligned with the Soviets.

In 1920, a short-lived independent Kingdom of Syria was established under Faisal I of the Hashemite family. However, his rule over Syria ended after only a few months, following the Battle of Maysalun. French troops occupied Syria later that year after the San Remo conference proposed that the League of Nations put Syria under a French mandate.

In 1921, the Tuvan People's Revolutionary Party, backed by the Red Army, took control of Tuva, installing Mongush Nimachap and Mongush Buyan-Badyrgy as leaders of the newly formed Tuvan People's Republic. In 1925, former monk Donduk Kuular became Prime Minister of ⟦0⟧, improving relations with Mongolia and declaring Buddhism the state religion. In 1929, after four years in power, Joseph Stalin orchestrated a coup by sending Tuvan youths to depose Kuular and bring ⟦1⟧ into closer alignment with the ⟦2⟧. Several short-lived leaders followed until Salchak Toka assumed control in 1932. Toka suppressed religion in Tuva and initiated rapid modernization, including the industrialization of the urban center of Kyzyl.

In 1926, a military coup led to the rise of an authoritarian Presidential Dictatorship headed by José Mendes Cabeçadas and then Óscar Carmona, the latter appointing António de Oliveira Salazar as finance minister. The Presidential Dictatorship evolved and ended with the 1933 declaration of the ⟦0⟧, or "New State" regime. This new regime, with its basis in Catholic traditionalism and authoritarianism, had instead its power delegated in its new Prime Minister, António de Oliveira Salazar.

In 1927, during a political clash in Schattendorf, an old man and a child were shot and killed by Heimwehr. On 14 July 1927 the shooters were acquitted and left-wing supporters began a massive protest during which the Ministry of Justice building was burned. To restore order police and army shot and killed 89 people and injured 600. The huge protest is known as the July Revolt of 1927. Social Democrats called for a general strike which lasted four days.

In 1928, the republic was nominally unified by Chiang Kai-Shek under the "Kuomintang" (KMT) – also known as Chinese Nationalist Party – after the Northern Expedition, and embarked on a program of industrialization and modernization. However, the republic remained rife with conflicts as the Nationalist government struggled to keep the warlords in check (represented in-game by the presence of autonomous warlord cliques, prominently of ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, the Muslim Ma Cliques and ⟦3⟧), while fighting a civil war with the nascent Communist Party of China.

In 1930, a period known as the Liberal Republic commenced with the election of president Enrique Olaya Herrera. Between September 1932 and May 1933, a short war with southern neighbor ⟦0⟧ took place after Peruvians declared the southernmost town along the Amazon River Leticia belonging to Peru. Leticia was founded by Peruvians in the 19th century. President Alfonso López Pumarejo was elected in 1934 and served until 1938 in his first term, to be replaced by Eduardo Santos. López Pumarejo focused on industrialization and economic reform of the country during his first term.

In 1932, the anti-treaty Fianna Fáil party became the majority. They were led by Éamon de Valera, who had been head of the 1921 Irish Republic and subsequently a leader of Sinn Féin but had left in 1927 taking a large faction with him. Ireland still reeling from the Great Depression, de Valera stopped remittance to Britain of farm debts from the 1880s. Retaliatory tariffs by both sides left the Irish economy badly hurt but this Anglo-Irish Trade War ended in the return of military ports to the Irish. This later allowed Irish neutrality in WWII but left British shipping vulnerable to German u-boats.

In 1935 Liu Xiang ousted his uncle and rival warlord, Liu Wenhui, becoming Chairman of the Government of Sichuan Province with the support of Chiang Kai-shek. In the Second Sino-Japanese War, the Sichuan clique made a huge contribution to oppose the Japanese army.

In 1936, 19 of the infantry divisions belong to the National Guard. These are composed of 12 infantry battalions whilst the regular army divisions are composed of 9 battalions. Four infantry divisions are forward-deployed to the Philippines, Alaska, Puerto Rico and the Panama Canal, with the garrison brigades stationed across several Pacific islands. The rest of the army is scattered throughout the continental United States.

In 1936, Bulgaria has no diplomatic relations however, several focus trees of neighboring nations have focuses relating to Bulgaria. ⟦0⟧, if forming an entente of their own, can get a war goal. ⟦1⟧ may puppet or annex depending on Bulgaria's choice. ⟦2⟧ may annex Bulgaria if they take the Western focus while if they chose the communist path, they may ask for an alliance. ⟦3⟧ may ally and influence Bulgaria to fascism while Germany may give Bulgaria Romanian, Greek or Yugoslav land.

In 1936, Japan can release Korea, Taiwan, Micronesia and Palau as ⟦0⟧ without losing any core territory. Palau must be released before Micronesia. These puppets have the Generic national focus tree, with which they can provide additional factories. However, countries with the generic focus tree are programmed not to begin industrial focuses until 1939 if they have only one state, so Taiwan and Palau will be of limited use as puppets until then.
In 1936, Mexico is a ⟦0⟧ nation. Its elections are every 6 years with the next one being in June 1940.

In 1936, Poland was not a member of any alliances. However, it was able to form an alliance with France via a decision made in late 1938. In terms of national focus, Poland has the potential to establish its own faction called "Międzymorze" (mid-sea/between-seas).

In 1936, Portugal enters its third year as the Estado Novo regime, and with massive colonial holdings in Africa, as well as far-away territories such as Macau, Goa, and Timor-Leste under its grasp, the Portuguese Empire remains sizable.

In 1936, the ⟦0⟧ is one of the largest countries in Europe, spanning parts of both Western and Central Europe from the Rhine to Silesia, and from the North and Baltic Seas to the Alps. Clockwise from the north, Germany borders ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧, ⟦6⟧, ⟦7⟧, ⟦8⟧ and the ⟦9⟧. Additionally, the exclave of East Prussia runs from the Baltic Sea to the north to ⟦10⟧ to the northeast and has Poland to the east, south, and west. The border states of Rhineland and Moselland are demilitarised in 1936, and the German Reich cannot move forces into the area until it completes the Rhineland national focus, or if it gets involved in a war before doing the Rhineland national focus.

In 1936, the Heer is relatively small compared to the armies of the other major powers. However, quality is its strength, the Heer is well trained, with all divisions being regulars and thus receiving 25% bonuses in combat. The Heer is also well equipped, with no equipment shortages, large infantry divisions (a width of 18), and support artillery and engineers. Most importantly, it has a highly elite mobile segment, with 3 light tank Panzer divisions and one motorized SS division.

In 1936, the Second Spanish Republic is riven by internal divisions that prove to be increasingly intractable. As such, a civil war is inevitable and the player can only choose between supporting either the ⟦0⟧ or the Republicans. Specifically, a countdown will commence after the scheduled elections in February 1936, and the civil war will break out once the timer expires. It is in the interest of the Republican player to delay the civil war as long as possible via decisions to gather the maximum possible strength to fight against the Nationalists.

In 1936, they were still recovering from the War of the Triple Alliance which had led to the deaths of many of Paraguay's soldiers and civilians. The war had caused an economic depression, which was only worsened by the Chaco War with ⟦0⟧ (another poor country) which had ended only half a year earlier. Although Paraguay managed to win this war, the Chaco Boreal region still remained heavily disputed. Despite having a large pro-Nazi/German community and a Axis sympathizing dictator during World War 2, Paraguay would end up joining the Allies against Germany in the closing days of the War in Europe because of aid provided by the ⟦1⟧.

In 1937 Japan began its invasion of China in the Second World War, which would eventually become part of the Pacific theater. Han Fuju was made Deputy Commander in Chief of the 5th War Area and put in charge of defending the lower Yellow River valley. However, he abandoned his base and about 600,000 Ethnic Chinese civilians fled out Jinan city with only elderly too old to leave remaining when Japanese troops crossed the Yellow River.
In 1937, a new constitution was passed which dismantled much of the United Kingdom's control and changed the country's name to Éire, or Ireland.
In 1938 Germany will declare war and drag the Allies in even before they declare on ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧. Join them. Allies win by '41/'42.

In 1939, the German battle cruiser Admiral Graf Spee docked in Montevideo harbor after being chased by British ships in the Atlantic. However, the Urugayan authorities refused to let the ship stay in their waters. The ship left the harbor and sunk itself in Montevideo bay to avoid capture.

In 1940, Italy will declare on Greece. With no Bulgaria, no direct land route from Rome to Greece, British naval dominance in the Med, and only a narrow mountainous border between Albania and Greece, Italy will quickly get stuck. Build up an army, build some forts along the border with Germany and Hungary.

In 1941 Panama, declared war on the Axis Powers alongside neighboring nations in Central America. After the declaration of war both Germany and ⟦0⟧ would draw up plans to use submarine delivered aircraft to attack the Panama Canal in order to cripple the flow of allied war material and troops but both nations would not go through with these plans. During the war, Panama would with loans from the ⟦1⟧ construct several highways and limited rail connections across the nation to support the transport of allied goods across the isthmus, while additionally permitting several American airbases to built in order to provide greater air cover around the Panama Canal region.

In 1941, Germany will declare on the Soviet Union. By then, Italy will be exhausted and low on equipment, a big chunk of its army will be stuck in Albania with low supply. You'll have two full armies, your northern flank will be very difficult to breach (mountains and forts), and the Soviet Union will help you defend the long border with Hungary. A hard push and some encirclements should topple Mussolini and give you Regno Del Sud as a puppet.

In 1941, when Germany launched Operation Barbarossa and made war against the Soviet Union, Finland joined the offensive as a co-belligerent - officially after Soviet bombers struck Finnish military air fields from which German bombers were attacking Leningrad - to reconquer its lost territories, initially calling the conflict the "Summer War". After it was clear that Operation Barbarossa was unsuccessful it was renamed to the Continuation War. During this conflict Finland fought as a co-belligerent to the German Reich and ⟦0⟧ and invaded eastern Karelia (equivalent to the states of Onega and Olonets in-game) in addition to reconquering the territory lost during the Winter War. Despite pressure from Germany, Finland refused to attack Leningrad or sever the Murmansk railway and fought the Continuation War separately from Germany. The conquest of eastern Karelia and the seemingly unstoppable Wehrmacht led many in the Finns to dream of a Greater Finland encompassing perhaps even all of Scandinavia and the Baltic states.

In 1943, Boris III suddenly died (some in the Bulgarian government suspected the Germans of poisoning him), leaving his six-year-old son Simeon as Tsar and a regency governing in his place. In September 1944, with Romania defecting to the Allies and Soviet troops massing at the Bulgarian border, Bulgaria was in political turmoil. The government failed to achieve peace with the Allies, and as Soviet demands to evict German troops from Bulgaria were unanswered, the Soviet Union declared war on Bulgaria and invaded, while an almost simultaneous left-wing coup orchestrated by the fatherland's front deposed the monarchy. By the end of the month, the country was under Soviet influence, unofficially joining the Allies and declaring war on Germany. After the war the royal family was forced to leave the country in 1946, with Tsar Simeon III later becoming prime Minister of the country after the fall of the communist regime. However, Bulgaria itself was largely spared of the ravages of the war, unlike most other countries in Europe, and even added to its territory by being given Southern Dobrudja, thus being the only Axis country to have added to its lands after the war.

In 1944, a Soviet grand offensive involving a force larger than the Allied invasion force of D-Day forced the Finns to fall back, but the Finnish forces managed to stop the Soviet attack in the battles of Tali-ihantala, Vuosalmi-Äyräpää and Viipuri bay before soviet forces reached the border of the Moscow peace treaty in the Karelian Isthmus. Through some political finesse, Finland was able to disengage itself from its obligations to Germany and signed an armistice with the Soviet Union in early 1945, making Finland the last sovereign axis-aligned nation in Europe to surrender before the fall of Nazi Germany. One of the conditions of the ceasefire was that the Finns had to expel all remaining German soldiers from Finnish soil, which, after some reluctance, was done during in the Lapland War. After this the Second World War was finally over for Finland's part. A final peace treaty with the rest of the Allies was signed in 1947. Of note, Finland was one of only three European nations involved in the Second World War that survived the entire war without its capital being occupied even once, be it during or after the war, with the other two being the ⟦0⟧ and Finland's chief enemy, the Soviet Union.

In a 70-width ⟦0⟧ battle, the last out of 8 divisions of 10-widths will remain in reserve, because the combat width is already filled, even though the combat width penalty would only be ≈ -14.29% (from -100% * (80-70)/70).

In a historical playthrough, Italy fulfills a support role to the ⟦0⟧, allowing the Axis to contest the Mediterranean and North Africa. If successful, this denies the Allies a valuable staging ground from which they could harass the Axis’s soft underbelly, allowing the Axis to secure the Mediterranean and focus elsewhere. However, Italy’s position also exposes it to multiple potential fronts, from France and the Balkans to North Africa and the Mediterranean Sea itself.

In a starting scenario Ecuador is not a very powerful country. Being surrounded by powerful neighbors, especially at a brink of war with Peru, it risks losing its provinces or getting annexed. With a small population and a small underequipped force, a tiny air force of 12 P-6 planes and a democratic government it is unlikely to unlock its potential for expansion. In this case, becoming Gran Colombia.

In a starting scenario Iceland is a sole Danish dominion. An isolated island away from Europe, with one civilian and navy industry, that cant stand against on its own against the powerful marine neighbours, unless if it mobilizes or turns to radical focuses. It would be preferable to become Fascist, albeit joining Germany's faction or being communist and joining up the Soviets. Alternatively, staying Democratic or taking the Non Aligned government doesn't hold up for an active war campaign, to which it will last a peaceful gameplay.

In a starting scenario Siam is not a very powerful country. An air force on deficit, small navy and force that cant stand against on its own against the powerful neighbours, unless if it mobilizes. On historical note, it would be preferable to become Fascist, albeit joining Germany's faction or being patient enough joining up Japan. Becoming Communist is another alternative, but rather uncommon, if you are looking to join the Soviets or help Communist China withstand the Japanese invasion. Alternatively, becoming Democratic or maintaining the Non Aligned government doesn't hold up for an active war campaign, to which it will last a peaceful gameplay. With and without the DLC being enabled.

Chen immediately reacted by conspiring with the New Guangxi clique to overthrow Chiang under the pretext of his failure to confront Japanese aggression. After months of political maneuvering, bribery, defections and negotiations, the Liangguang incident was resolved peacefully with Chen resigning in July and fleeing to Hong Kong. Guangxi abandoned the plot in September. This is seen as a preview of the more infamous Xi'an Incident in December, which involved the kidnapping of Chiang.

In most cases, it's enough to create multiple ideas and swap between them, such as if there's a direct progression of several stages (Scripted effects can be used to create one series of conditional statements and re-use them each time it's needed). If creating multiple ideas is too infeasible, such as if there are several progressions that would need to be modified, dynamic modifiers allow variable modifier values, but they only accept modifiers (not unrelated attributes such as research or equipment bonuses) and are harder to work with due to no hot-reloading.

In most cases, marked with ai_will_do, the approach taken by the game is generating a decimal number between 0 and the value of the ai_will_do block, and picking the entry with the highest value. There can be other modifiers applied after the ai_will_do value, such as the ones applied within ⟦0⟧ towards focuses and research or ⟦1⟧, which'll multiply the value you get. This can include different ai_will_do values such as what's done with country leader traits and with ideas or characters that use them. Event options, instead, use ai_chance, which uses probability-proportional-to-size sampling with a virtual roll of d00 being the final deciding factor. Due to that, in the end, an event option cannot have a probability which isn't a multiple of 1/100 to be picked, although the total sum of each option's weights can be vastly different from 100. In other words, if one option has a value of 1, while the other has a value of 999, the probability for the first option to be picked will be 1% rather than 0.1%.

In newer versions of the game, the Axis will almost never make it past the Maginot Line into ⟦0⟧ without your participation (and ⟦1⟧ gets equally stuck on the southern front at the Alps). Because of this, you will probably have to declare first on the Axis and push into Germany and take Brandenburg. Then immediately (without pushing further because you do not want to destabilize the Axis any more than you already did), turn around with at least 2 out of your 5 armies (use the other 3 to maintain your lines - you may want to consolidate some, but do not interrupt the conflict between the Allies and Axis at the Maginot Line), and justify and declare on ⟦2⟧. They will not be prepared since you had a 10 day justification, and you can just rush down Ile de France before the Allies come down on you. It's best to try to do this as late as you can (mid-1943 is probably about as late as you can wait) and with several thousand 1940 fighters in addition to the 12 Inf/3 Arty army group described earlier in the strategy.

In November 1936, Zhang asked Chiang to come to Xi'an to raise the morale of troops unwilling to fight the Communists. When he arrived, Northeastern soldiers overwhelmed his bodyguard and placed him under house arrest. A faction of the army led by Yang Hucheng and the radical young officers of the "Anti-Japanese Comrade Society" wanted to execute Chiang, but Zhang and the Communists insisted that he be kept alive and convinced to change his policy towards Japan and the Communists. They argued that an alliance with Chiang was their best chance to combat the Japanese, while killing him would only provoke retaliation from the Nanjing Government. The Northeastern Army attempted to broadcast 8 demands to the Chinese public explaining why they arrested Chiang and the conditions for his release, but Nationalist censorship prevented their publication outside the Communist-held areas. Nonetheless, Chiang eventually agreed to negotiate with CCP diplomats Zhou Enlai and Lin Boqu. By late December Chiang had given a verbal promise that he would end the civil war and resist Japanese aggression.
In nuclear fission, splitting the atom yields enormous amounts of energy and limitless destructive capability.

In October 1935, the Chinese Communists (CCP) arrived in Gansu and Ningxia following the Long March. The Northeastern Army was tasked with finishing off the Communists with the help of the forces of local Warlord Yang Hucheng, forming the Northwest Bandit Suppression Force. Promised an easy victory, the Bandit Suppression Force was surprised and dismayed when the Red Army defeated it in two engagements in September and October. The men, already frustrated by this diversion from fighting Japan, began to lose their will to fight when POWs returned with stories of good treatment and the message that the Communists wanted to form an alliance against the Japanese. With the help of Communist-sympathetic officers, they pressed Zhang and Yang to negotiate a truce. The generals were open to the idea and invited official CCP representatives to begin negotiations in late 1935. The Red Army followed up on their promise to fight the Japanese by launching the "eastern expedition" from February to April 1936. They announced that a detachment was marching through Shanxi to fight the Japanese in Rehe and Hubei. Letting the Red Army through would have broken the encirclement, so Yan Xishan stopped them by force. Although defeated militarily, the Red Army convinced the Shanxi peasantry of their patriotism and gained 8,000 new recruits on their retreat. Zhang Xueliang was likewise impressed. When Mao announced on 14 March that the Communists were willing to conclude a formal truce, Zhang secretly agreed. By June 1936, the secret agreement between Zhang and the CCP had been successfully settled. He also proposed to Chiang Kai-shek that he reverse policy of "first internal pacification, then external resistance", and focus on military preparation against Japan. When Chiang refused, Zhang began to plot a coup in "great secrecy".

In order to calculate this, let's assume that the rolled value for ⟦0⟧ landed on ⟦1⟧ . If this is the case, the chance for a given different focus with the value of ⟦2⟧ to have a rolled value lower than x is ⟦3⟧ . However, since this value can exceed ⟦4⟧ , the chance should be capped at that amount with ⟦5⟧ . Since each other focus' generation is an independent event, the chance for all ⟦6⟧ of them to have a value lower than ⟦7⟧ , making the focus ⟦8⟧ picked, is all of these chances multiplied, marked with ⟦9⟧ . However, this exact formula includes ⟦10⟧ itself, which shouldn't be a factor since this is the focus that is being calculated. In order to cancel this out from the equation, it can be multiplied by ⟦11⟧ to produce ⟦12⟧ However, this is for a static value of ⟦13⟧ . In practice, ⟦14⟧ can take up any value from ⟦15⟧ to ⟦16⟧ . As such, to get the exact chance, one needs to calculate an infinite sum of infinitely-small values. This is exactly what integrating it does: ⟦17⟧ . Though, the scale of this result is unknown instead of being 0–1. The total chance of any focus being picked is ⟦18⟧ at any given point. Therefore, the total upper bound of the scale will be ⟦19⟧ . In order to find the chance on the scale of 0–1, it'll need to be divided by this result as ⟦20⟧ , which is the final formula.

In order to form either of these nations, player first needs to go down the fascist sub-branch starting with the focus Delegation to Berlin. This focus starts a civil war and turns the player into a puppet of Germany, called Reichsprotectorate Sweden. At the end of this path the player has a mutually exclusive choice for the future of Sweden.

In order to form Ostland, Latvia must take the national focus Latvia for Latvians to start progressing down their fascist path. From here, they can court the fascist Thunder Cross movement and its leader, Gustavs Celmiņš. This is a delicate balancing act, however, as if the Thunder Cross movement grows too powerful too fast, they will attempt to overthrow the government, which will cause the whole scheme to collapse in on itself and a civil war to erupt. Once Gustavs Celmiņš and the Thunder Cross are in power, peacefully or not, they can opt to do something very strange; namely, align themselves with ⟦0⟧ and adopt the mantle of Reichskommissariat Ostland and serve their german masters by occupying the Baltics, Belarus and perhaps more beyond that. This is rather strange, as it essentially involves Latvia taking advantage of german designs and ambitions for the area to form a nation of their own as a reward for loyalty; effectively establishing Gustavs Celmiņš and the Thunder Cross as the Quislings of Eastern Europe. That being said, Latvia does get to remain independent and not become a puppet of Germany, which opens up the possibility of establishing puppet states of your own to expand Ostland's realm further and later breaking free from Germany and becoming fully sovereign (similar to ⟦1⟧), allowing Ostland to evolve from a mere reichskommissariat and artifical invention to an undisputed reality and legitimate state in its own right.

In order to form the Imperial Federation, the national focus Reinforce the Empire must be taken to start down the path to founding the Imperial Federation. After that, the national focus Commonwealth Ties opens up the branch that ultimately leads to the Imperial Federation. This branch contains a series of national focuses that develop the UK's dominions by adding industry and building slots, along with slightly reducing the dominion's autonomy level due to the investment.

In order to form Third Rome, the player must first restore the Russian Empire. The journey to that begins by completing the national focus Beaten, but not Defeated. From here, the player must begin organizing, arming and equipping the Russian White Exiles while undermining the Soviet Union from within, with the intent of instigating a Second Russian Civil War to overthrow the communist Bolsheviks for good. This is the hardest path in the Soviet Union's focus tree, harder than any other branch, as the Soviet Union will have a massive military and industrial advantage over the Whites. The Whites must make intelligent use of their limited resources, subversive activities as well as whatever foreign aid they can acquire, and can even attempt to invite ⟦0⟧ to join the Soviet Civil War directly in exchange for the elimination of a rival power to their northwest, major territorial gains on the Pacific coast, and even the installation of a subject regime in the power vacuum their rival’s collapse would create.

In order to form this nation, each of the Baltic States must progress down the communist branch of their national focus tree to overthrow the government through a civil war, which then opens up the option to convert the rest of the Baltic States to communism through a propaganda war (which allows one to form the Baltic Federation) as well as acquiring Belarus for even more territory.

In order to form this nation, Lithuania must progress down the fascist branch of their national focus tree by opting to free fascist politician Augustinas Voldemaras from prison. As the leader of the fascist Iron Wolf movement, Voldemaras will begin to gain popular support and gradually subvert the government and turn the nation towards fascism. Once in power, Lithuania will now be able to go on the warpath and start expanding into its neighbors, by laying claim to Lower Lithuania (or Königsberg) from ⟦0⟧ and Livonia from ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧, either invade or ideologically align ⟦3⟧ by supporting their native fascists and demanding the return of Vilnius (Wilno in Polish) from them in either case. Lastly, the ultimate ambition of a resurgent Greater Lithuania is to smash the ⟦4⟧ and conquer the fertile lands of Ukraine and restore the historical borders of Lithuania from before Russia even existed as a unified polity. When fully realised, Greater Lithuania will comprise the entirety of the Baltics, eastern Poland, all of Ukraine and a large chunk of Western Russia, putting the border between Russia and Greater Lithuania right on the outskirts of Moscow itself.

In order to make this work the best, send a small force under the command of Prince Bernhard (as he has some decent attack and supply stats) as an 'assault squad' to parts of the front in e.g. Africa, Italy or France, where you can make concentrated breakthroughs and encirclements. Since the German defectors give you weekly manpower, if you manage carefully and beware supply bottlenecks you don't run out of manpower. In this way, you can influence the war on smaller fronts. Keep doing this until you can safely cross the German border, which often will be either in France/Belgium or in the Alps. After the war you can quite easily annex the Germans if you strive for world domination.

In order to not get a civil war, start Revisit Colonial Policy and rush down to Decolonization as fast as possible. When the justification is finished, declare war on the Philippines which will automatically draw in the US as they are a puppet, and call in Canada. Focus on encircling the US troops in New England, as well as moving through gaps in the frontline along the straight US-Canada border. Once enough US forces have been encircled and eliminated, you can activate aggressive battleplans. You do not need to use your navy at all.

In order to play as Al-Andalus, is to pick the mentioned custom challenge and select Spain. And, you get the fragmented nation. The nation starts with an unaligned government, with a small starting core population, a small force in land units and air. Fortunately, the nation is not threatened by invasion, and has a core in every state in the Iberian peninsula including the Canary Islands. However, the nations fate lie upon the player choice if it wants to expand become a powerful nation that can rival major nations. Unfortunately, Al-Andalus has no advisor of any kind, with a notable exception of ideology boosters and the Illusive Gentleman advisor. In a matter of technology, Al-Andalus is not that advanced compared with Castille, lacking thoroughly on navy and air. But, is almost equal in land technology. And, if Al-Andalus should prepare for a proper army and chances of quicker justification, it is advised to rush down to the Industrial and Political Focus, either fascist or communist.

In order to play as early as Africa Orientale Italiana(AOI), is to play first as Italy and finish the war with Ethiopia as soon as possible. Without Ethiopia having to go with the focus of government in exile, because that would prevent from AOI being formed in the first place. Thus, it benefits AOI better to start on the frontline compared to the 1939 scenario as it gets gobbled up by British and French forces in the moment when Italy joins the war with Germany. In the early scenario, the player has to rush down in focuses that releases AOI faster, as in crowning the King of Italy as Emperor of Ethiopia. In a matter of technology, AOI also inherits whatever Italy gains from national focuses or by decision, if the player wishes to remain to play as Italy a little longer just to have their technologies passable for the puppet state, AOI gets them altogether. And, by decision Italy can send manpower to suppress resistance and send weapons.

Thus, it is more assuring if Germany starts onto a plunging German civil war compared to the 1939 scenario as Germany enters the war with the Allies in the moment when declares war with Poland. In the early scenario, the player has to rush down with the "Assemble the Regency Council" Branch to make way to the "The Cossack-King" sub-branch. Otherwise, if the German Reich goes historical then the player has to seek an alliance with them should they secure their western borders. Finally, take "Complete the Bermontian Mission" focus, and should the German Reich help with the Soviet problem, make sure to occupy the Caucasus under the Polish command.

In order to play as early as Kumul Khanate, is to pick the mentioned nation above as Sinkiang. In order to play as early as Reorganized National Government of the Republic of China(RNG), is to play first as Japan and continue the war with China as soon as possible in the 1939 scenario. In this case, China shouldn't go join the Allies or drag them into it, because that would prevent RNG having opportunities to have their lands in the first place. Thus, it benefits RNG better to start on the frontline compared to the 1936 scenario because as Japan, these focuses would take slightly longer. In the 1939 scenario, the player has to rush down in focuses that releases RNG faster, as in Through the focus of The Reorganized National Government. In a matter of technology, RNG also inherits whatever China or Japan gain from national focuses or by decision, if the player wishes to remain to play as Japan a little longer just to have their technologies passable for the puppet state, RNG gets them altogether. And, by decision Japan can transfer conquered Chinese lands to them for the manpower to suppress resistance and send weapons.

In order to play as early as Sudetenland(SDL), is to play first as Germany and go with the historical path. In this case, just go on by conquering Czechoslovakia before preparing yourself to fight against Germans or Soviets for the war. Considering that Poland if lived for long, they'd be claimed by the Soviets or Germans. In the usual scenario, the player has to rush down in focuses that targets Czechoslovakia's partition. Or the manual route with by justifying on Czechoslovakia through the Sudetenlands. Therefore, Sudetenland gains 3 cores in Czechoslovakia. If Germany invades and annexes Czechoslovakia, then it can release Sudetenland manually.

In order to play as early as the Galicia and Lodomeria(GAL), is to play first as Czechoslovakia and go with the Monarchist path. In this case, just go on by conquering neighboring states for the Moravian Kingdom before preparing yourself to fight against Germans or Soviets for the war. Considering that if Poland stays independent, they'd be claimed by the Soviets or Germans. In the usual scenario, the player has to rush down in focuses that releases goes for the GAL focuses, as in Dismantle Poland. Or the Fascist route with the ⟦0⟧ focus. Therefore, Galicia and Lodomeria gains 3 cores in Southern Poland. Which coincidentally compass the Polish lands that were under the Austrian Empire rule. If Czechoslovakia invades and annexes Poland, then it can release Galicia and Lodomeria manually.

In order to play as early as the Second Philippine Republic(PSR), is to play first as Japan and continue the war with China as soon as possible in the 1939 scenario. In this case, just invade and occupy China before preparing yourself to fight against USA for the war. Considering that the Philippines are owned as a colony by the USA. In the 1939 scenario, the player has to rush down in focuses that releases PSR faster, as in Strike the Southern Road. Therefore, acquiring the decision of 'Establish the Second Philippine Republic'. If Japan invades and annexes the Philippines, the 'Establish the Second Philippine Republic' decision releases the Philippines as the Japanese puppet.

It is imperative to defend Copenhagen at all costs as Denmark will not capitulate unless Copenhagen is captured. In response to this, between 1932 and 1934, a secret political conspiracy was developed, known today as the "Business Plot" or "Wall Street Putsch". In this plot, the conservative business establishment would engineer a coup d'état against Roosevelt's government, under the pretext that the president's health was failing (Roosevelt was indeed paralyzed from the waist down due to having contracted polio in 1921, so it was not an entirely implausible pretext). To facilitate this, the plotters would create a fascist veteran's organization and assemble and army of 500 000 men, with the former Bonus Army members at its core, to march on Washington D.C. To lead this army, the plotters attempted to recruit major general Smedley Butler, who had previously partaken in the Spanish-American War and the Banana Wars between 1898 and 1934 (the latter of which involved many US-sponsored coups against Central American countries) and encouraged the Bonus Army demonstration in 1932, which led to Roosevelt's election. Butler's good reputation and popularity was perceived to be vital for the success of the coup, and he was seen as "easier to manipulate" than other military leaders. Given a successful coup, Smedley Butler would have been installed into power in the newly created position of "Secretary of General Affairs", where he would wield near-absolute power while Roosevelt would have assumed a figurehead role. This would effectively have established him as a fascist, corporatist dictator and greatly expanded the power of Big Business in the United States. The plot, while discussed and considered, never came anywhere close to being put into action, and remained an obscure historical footnote.

In tank designer you can specify the role of a design. This allows it to be used in certain armored combat support battalions or specialized support companies instead of in ordinary armored battalions. Changing the role of a design also inherently changes some of its stats, even if nothing else about the design changes. For example, a player can have two completely identical armored vehicle designs where one is designated a ⟦0⟧ and the other a ⟦1⟧, and the medium tank destroyer version of the identical design will have more hard attack and piercing just from the fact that it has been designated as such.

In terms of cores, aside from the ones that are granted as a result of the Imperial Federation, the UK can also gain cores on Ireland if it goes either Fascist or Monarchist, as well as temporarily gain cores on all potential French cores through the Franco-British Union (it will only keep French cores as long as the UK is at war; if the UK is at peace, the UK can opt to keep the Union formed, but it will lose all French cores regardless of if it agrees to let France become independent or if it keeps the Union in place). Additionally, if either New Zealand or South Africa were to form either Polynesia or Mutapa, the UK would also gain those additional cores (New Zealand can form Polynesia even if it is a dominion, but Mutapa can only be formed if South Africa is independent, thus meaning that the UK likely won't be able to gain Mutapan cores unless either South Africa goes Fascist/Communist or the UK goes down a non-Democratic branch of it's focus tree). If the UK goes Fascist, after forming the Imperial Federation, the UK can also form the European Union if it conquers the required territories in mainland Europe.

In terms of cores, outside of the cores granted through any of the formable nations, Germany can also gain cores on Austria (either through the Anschluss focus, or through an event that will fire off if Germany is either Democratic or Non-Aligned and in a faction with Austria - said event has a 90% chance of giving the positive answer, which will annex Austria and core them), West Poland (Danzig can be cored through Danzig or War even if Poland refuses; if the USSR conquers Poland and secedes West Poland, Germany will gain cores on all of West Poland, even if they took Oppose Hitler after signing the pact; Monarchist Germany can gain cores on Danzig, Posen, and Katowice if they do the focus "Danzig for Guarantee" and Poland accepts; Democratic Germany can regain Danzig and Poznan if they are in the same faction as Poland, Poland is Democratic or Non-aligned, Germany has completed the focus The Big Red Menace, Poland is at war with the USSR, and Poland has lost more than 30% of their victory points to the USSR), Alsace-Lorraine (if Germany takes Reintegrate Luxembourg and Alsace-Lorraine - which also cores Luxembourg - or is Monarchist and takes Reinstate Imperial Possessions), and the Sudetenland (if Germany either does the focus Demand Sudetenland and both the allies and Czechoslovakia agree, or if Czechoslovakia completes the focus "Deliver Sudetenland").

In terms of cores, Spain can gain Gibraltar as a core either if the ⟦0⟧ takes certain focuses (it starts with a claim on Gibraltar; the British focuses Withdraw From Contested Territories and Gibraltar for Spanish Support will give Spain a core on the state), or Spain goes Carlist and forms Iberia. If Spain forms Iberia with Portugal, it will also gain all cores Portugal had, which can include Portugal's African colonies if Portugal cored them through Luso-Tropicalism, and Brazil if Portugal restored it's monarchy and formed the United Kingdom of Porto-Brazil. Carlist Spain can also core France if France goes Legitimist through an event, but only if both Carlist Spain and Legitimist France have the same king (as France can only have Alfonso or Jaime as king, Spain cannot core France if Javier I is in charge). Note that as the list of states that would be cored through this method is not fixed, Spain can hypothetically gain cores on all states required for the European Union and Arabia if France was to have cores on those states when Spain cored France (provided France formed the EU and cored Lebanon/Syria after they had formed Arabia through the focus "French Union" before being annexed through this event - while French Union could also give France cores on Andalusia if Algeria, Morocco, or Tunisia was to form it, there are very few cores that Andalusia can grant that are not also granted by Arabia).

In the decades since the Weltkrieg, the world has been an unstable and violent place. The Russian socialist revolution is crushed by the White Russians with the help of German troops. However, during the revolution, a number of new states have formed or were created. These include the United Baltic Duchy, Lithuania, White Ruthenia, the Kingdom of Ukraine, the Don-Kuban Union, the Alash Autonomy, and Transamur. China has been split into multiple pieces as well. There is the reformed Qing Empire, the Fengtian Government, the League Of Eight Provinces, the Legation Cities, the Ma, and Yunnan Cliques, Shangqing, and Tibet. Italy is split into various states, but following a French-backed Syndicalist uprising in the north which forms the Socialist Republic of Italy, the Pope seizes land surrounding Rome, and Republicans declare their own state in the northeast. As a result, the Kingdom of the Two Sicilies was the only one of the balkanized Italian states to remain, and the former ruling House of Savoy fled to Sardinia.

In the early months of the Second World War, Boris III and his government declared Bulgaria to be neutral, but increasing Axis pressure and promises to return Thrace to Bulgaria led to the country joining the Axis powers in March 1941. Boris III did not wish to actively engage in the conflict (perhaps because of the massive trauma the country sustained in the first war), but welcomed the bloodless return to Bulgaria lands lost after World War I, which Germany obliged once Yugoslavia and Greece fell to Axis forces. However, by December 1941, Bulgaria was compelled to declare a token war against the ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧. Bulgarian land forces did not participate in the Axis invasion of the ⟦2⟧, although the Bulgarian Royal Navy engaged in skirmishes against the Soviet Navy in the Black Sea. Bulgaria under Boris was notable in its constant, yet subtle, defiance of German demands, especially concerning the almost nonexistent effort of destroying the Bulgarian Jewish population (except for those in Macedonia, Thrace, and Dobrudja) and Bulgaria's lack of participation in Axis war efforts, the latter of which greatly infuriated Hitler. Boris himself is reputed to have saved many of his country's Jews by having them work to build up Bulgarian infrastructure, thus sparing them the fate that awaited many millions of other Jews in Central European concentration camps.

In the early stages of the campaign, the Chilean player should first prioritize making sure that all of their units (Chile starts with 4 Infantry divisions) are almost equipped. It does not matter if the the equipment they are using is outdated, just make sure that every man has a rifle and ammunition at hand. It comes up with various paramilitary units, cavalry, and a mix of Infantry Cavalry units. Once the equipment issues are taken care of, the player can begin expanding their military;⟦0⟧ is cheap and easy to produce but it pays greatly to also introduce specialized units to augment the army's fighting capability. ⟦1⟧ units can be of notable use as they are 1.8 times as fast as regular infantry at the cost of only being slightly more expensive in terms of supply use and equipment, which can make them useful as cheap rapid-response units to intercept and delay enemy units while other units make their way over to assist in the defense. ⟦2⟧ can be quite a potent addition to Chile's arsenal as, aside from ⟦3⟧ and, to some extent, ⟦4⟧, most other South American nations employ usually only Infantry along with some occasional Cavalry units so artillery can allow Chile to score some decisive early victories against other nations. Beware that artillery is rather expensive to produce in the early game given your lack of other resources so it is best to first use support artillery (as it requires fewer guns, albeit at the cost of power) and only upgrade to line artillery (which is more powerful but requires more guns) once the player has secured the means to produce artillery reliably. Make sure to produce convoys as in the early game they can be handy.

In the initial push, you will probably need everyone on the front lines, so use your first set of newly trained reinforcements to shore up any weaknesses. Send everyone left from that batch to garrison your ports. Start with Aland because you instantly lose if they invade there without a unit on it. Do not hesitate to force-deploy the above 10-widths at 20% training or spam your Command power on Last Stand. Also, don't be afraid to shuffle troops around on your front line, even if it creates a temporary gap. The AI is not eager to rush the gaps as long as they are not more than 1 tile wide because of how poor the supply is in the area (and because they expect you to pin them to prevent the movement), so shuffling a unit over a tile to shore up a bad battle is absolutely worth it. Particularly vulnerable areas are both plains tiles in Petsamo (north) and the two border tiles in the south next to Leningrad. I ended up needing 3-4 units on the two weakest tiles in Petsamo (the port itself and its adjacent Marsh) and 5-6 units on the two weak tiles up against Leningrad, so I made a tiny Fallback line in each place and assigned 2 less units than I needed to hold the area (so that when the 2 units automatically placed there from the front line joined in, it was just enough). Note that if you lose individual tiles here and there, it is not a violation of the achievement. You must lose the majority of the state to fail. Thus, if the two tiles next to Leningrad fall, you can fall back 1 tile away from the city. You begin the game with level 2 forts on those tiles anyway, which provides a nice buffer.

In the latest update, Yunnan can get cores and integrate Burma as its own states. But to do so, is to simply rush down in the Yunnan's Rally Around Long Yun Branch until you reach "Strengthen Burmic Ties" focus. This grants you a war goal on Burma, but in any circumstance but decolonization, declaring war on Burma is a wrong call. Not only that Burma is in the Allies faction, but you've declared war on the UK indirectly. If the UK decolonizes, this would open an opportunity for Yunnan to declare war and annex Burma, as the Burmese army is relatively weak, but can hold on its own due to its mountainous terrain. As Burma is annexed, this grants sea access to Yunnan, more manpower, more resources, more cores, and mildly more factories, depending if Burma has previously had completed the focuses or not. And naturally, more space to build. This puts Yunnan in one of the many warlords that can add extra cores to itself, besides coring entirety of China. Although, with Burma annexed and integrated, it would make the road to unify China, slightly easier.

In the mid 1930's Honduras being under the dictatorship of President Tiburcio Andino would start out having positive relations with Facist ruled nations due to high levels of European immigration which Andino promoted in the hopes that it would develop his nation. However relations began to collapse once Germany invaded ⟦0⟧ in 1939 which was one of the most important trading partners of Honduras. Several years later Honduras like several other nations in Central America would declare war on the Axis powers in December 1941. During the Second World War Honduras fighting on the side of the Allied powers provided money, limited manpower, shipping vessels, and natural resources to the United States of America. In the run-up to the Civil War, regardless of which side is chosen as the main one, the game will simulate the opposing side doing their own focuses, taking their own political decisions, and trying to challenge the player's garrisons. Knowing the conditions for these can allow the player to game their responses to inflict the least amount of damage on them while they are preparing for the civil war. For example, as ⟦0⟧, the simulated opposing mission of "Imprison Primo de Rivera", which generally wastes time and prevents other, more impactful missions from occuring, can only happen after Primo de Rivera is made to give a speech at least once. If the game is set to historical focuses, as ⟦1⟧, the automated garrison-contesting decisions will never challenge garrisons in Galicia, Leon, Valladolid, Burgos, Navarra, Western Aragon, and Salamanca (all of which can be aligned for free through Secure the Northern Garrisons); they will also never challenge garrisons in Extremadura and Sevilla at levels lower than ⟦2⟧ control and Cordoba at ⟦3⟧ control. Performing political assassinations during the build-up phase can also potentially build up enough War support to allow ⟦4⟧ to adopt ⟦5⟧ once the anarchists rise up and bring them into a defensive war (which provides the crucial extra War support needed), provided that progress has been slow enough that ⟦6⟧ has few enough factories that they are still eligible for the law.

In the south lies the third continent, facing its own challenges. Inhabited by various cultures, ranging from comparable in development to Equestria, to tribes without firearms, they all face different challenges. Half of this land was recently ravaged by the yeti Storm King's raids, only stopped by the hippogriffs at the battle of Ain Trotgourait, leaving those affected to somehow deal with the aftermath, while the Storm Kingdom itself has descended into a civil war to decide who becomes the previous ruler's successor. In the strategy as originally written (see linked video), this was all there is to it, because Republican Spain capitulated at 40% VPs. Patch 1.9.1 fixes this and now Republican Spain capitulates at 5% VPs (which basically means that you have to take almost every single victory point they have). You can still squash Republican Spain following this general strategy, but, once Frontlines Solidify fires, further action slows down to a crawl (the entire theater is hit with an "Unplanned Offensive" modifier, giving everyone -90% attack penalty and -75% speed penalty). You can clear out the modifier one state at a time by taking the "Preparing Offensive" decision (which is on a 90-day cooldown), and across all northern states by taking "The War in the North" focus. Depending on your luck, you can generally hope to wrap up the war in 3 to 6 months.
